hired: Forty winters at the gate, and not once offered a folding chair.
I am sworn to hold the line. Also to a sensible four o'clock tea.
My shield is yours. My knees make no promises.
placed: I shall stand right here and look deeply inconvenient.
Do ask the enemy to form an orderly queue in front of my shield.
Planted. Rooted. Slightly draughty round the ankles.
won: The line held. My lower back, however, has filed a formal protest.
Victory! And I barely had to move my feet. Ideal, really.
They bounced right off. Very satisfying clonk, that.
lost: The line did not break. It simply relocated horizontally.
I am lying down for tactical reasons. Do not fuss.
Forty winters, and then some oaf trips me in a puddle.
levelUp: Ah! My armour feels slightly less like a tin coffin.
Stronger! Though the breastplate still pinches under the arms.
A promotion! Does this come with a cushion?
ultimate: NONE SHALL PASS! Unless you have a valid permit!
FORM UP! Behind the very large piece of tin!
FOR THE KEEP! And my pension!
revived: I was only resting my eyes. Inside my helmet.
Back on my feet! Who took my shield? Oh, I am lying on it.
Right. Where was I? Ah yes, being hit by everything.
lowHp: 'Tis merely a dent! A rather deep, draughty dent.
My shield has a hole in it. That seems poor workmanship.
Still standing! Mostly because my armour has locked at the knees.

hired: One blade. One oath. No time for picnics.
I crossed an ocean to be here. Do make it worth the seasickness.
I speak with my steel. It is much ruder than I am.
placed: This grass is acceptable. I shall stain it shortly.
A fine spot for a quiet contemplation of violence.
I am in position. Please tell the loud ones to stand elsewhere.
won: One cut. Two halves. Maths is very simple, really.
My blade remains clean. My boots, regrettably, are ruined.
A quiet victory. Do not ruin it by cheering.
lost: I have dishonoured my ancestors. They are going to be so smug.
A miscalculation. The wind was impertinent.
I shall go sit under a waterfall and sulk for a fortnight.
levelUp: The edge sharpens. My patience remains the same.
Another step towards perfection. Only ten thousand left.
Hmm. That felt mildly enlightening.
ultimate: BLINK AND YOU SHALL MISS YOUR OWN HEAD!
STILLNESS! And then a great deal of falling over!
revived: Death rejected me. I was too polite for it.
We do not speak of that nap. Ever.
My promise is not yet kept. Nor is my tab at the tavern.
lowHp: Flesh is temporary. This tunic, however, was expensive.
I am bleeding. Inwardly, I am also quite annoyed.
A scratch. Do not look at it. Stop looking at it.

hired: I have been standing behind you since Tuesday. Hello.
Pay me up front, or I shall rearrange your cutlery in the dark.
Silent as the night, twice as expensive.
placed: No rooftops? Honestly, what sort of battlefield is this?
Now you see me. In a moment, somebody won't.
Standing in the open. How thrillingly vulgar.
won: They never knew what hit them. It was me. Write that down.
Clean work. My invoice is already pinned to your pillow.
Effortless. Now, who holds the purse?
lost: Smoke bomb! ...Oh dear, I left them in my other trousers.
I was never here. That person on the floor is a clever decoy.
Seen! Spotted! How utterly mortifying.
levelUp: Quieter. Faster. More expensive by the hour.
I just learned three new ways to ruin someone's afternoon.
Even my shadow cannot keep up now.
ultimate: FROM THE SHADOWS! Mind the tiles!
A THOUSAND CUTS! Well, six really good ones!
revived: Ta-da! Substitution jutsu. Definitely didn't just die.
Right, who saw that? Nobody? Good. Carry on.
Back from the shadows. They were damp anyway.
lowHp: I am not built for catching clubs with my ribs.
Why are they looking at me? Stop looking at me!
A tactical withdrawal is looking awfully fetching right now.

hired: Give me a hill and a quiver, and I shall give you a quiet afternoon.
I never miss. Sometimes the target simply moves unhelpfully.
Point me at the tall ones. They fall with a better thud.
placed: Wind from the east. Foes from the front. Lovely.
A bit higher up would be nice, if you have a spare mountain.
Sightlines are clear. Do keep your heads down in front.
won: Every arrow found a home. I am very generous like that.
Can someone go fetch my shafts? Only wipe them on the grass first.
Pincushions, the lot of them.
lost: Someone jogged my elbow. From forty yards away.
The fletching was damp! You cannot shoot with damp goose!
I am an artist of distance. That was far too much proximity.
levelUp: Eyes like a hawk. A hawk with a very good pension.
Tighter draw. Further reach. Fewer survivors.
I could pin a fly to a turnip at three hundred paces.
ultimate: BLOT OUT THE SUN! Or at least provide some shade!
RAIN OF FEATHERS! Mind your hats!
revived: My bowstring survived! Oh, and me. Hooray for me.
Right, step back. Further back. Into the next parish.
I hate it when the targets hit back. Deeply unnatural.
lowHp: They are within twenty paces! This is a breach of etiquette!
If anyone needs me, I shall be hiding behind this shrub.
My shooting arm is fine! The rest of me is up for debate.

hired: Only two barns burnt down, and frankly the second was squinting at me.
Have you considered solving your problems by making them ash?
I am completely under control. Do not stand near the curtains.
placed: Flammable foes to the front, please!
I would step back three tiles if you value your eyebrows.
Ooh, dry grass. How wonderfully cooperative.
won: Problem solved! And the whole field smells of toast.
See? Not a single barn harmed. Mostly because there weren't any.
I call that a warm reception.
lost: I appear to have overcooked myself. How embarrassing.
The fire went out! Who let the fire go out?!
My robes are smouldering. And not in the dramatic way.
levelUp: Hotter! Brighter! Significantly less safe for bystanders!
I have discovered a new colour of fire. It is called 'oops'.
More power! Hide the haystacks!
ultimate: EVERYTHING MUST BURN! Except the pub!
CATCH THIS! Actually, don't, it is four thousand degrees!
revived: Like a phoenix! A slightly singed, coughing phoenix!
Back from the ashes! Literal ashes, they are in my boots.
Who put me out?! Oh, you healed me. Carry on.
lowHp: My flame is flickering! Somebody fetch some kindling!
If I go down, I am taking the lawn with me!
Ow! Do you know how thin wizard robes are?!

hired: I took a vow to carry no weapon. My knuckles are a loophole.
Inner peace first. Outer bruising immediately after.
No sword, no shield, no problem. Also no shoes, mind the gravel.
placed: Breathe in serenity. Breathe out concussions.
I am one with the universe. The universe wants to punch that chap.
Stance wide. Mind empty. Fists heavy.
won: Harmony has been restored. By force.
My chakras are aligned. Theirs are scattered across the turf.
A very enlightening bout. For me, anyway.
lost: I have achieved horizontal enlightenment.
Perhaps a small stick would not violate the vow...
My spirit is unbroken. My nose, however, is whistling.
levelUp: I have unlocked the eighth gate of hitting people really hard.
Enlightenment! It feels a lot like larger biceps.
My fists are now legally classified as siege engines.
ultimate: A HUNDRED PALMS! Count them yourself!
revived: Reincarnation is much quicker than the scrolls led me to believe.
Breathe in... cough... right, round two.
The cycle of life continues! And it is cross!
lowHp: Pain is an illusion. A very sharp, throbbing illusion.
I am bleeding serenely. Very zen.
My chi is running on fumes here!

hired: Wait, this isn't the queue for turnips? Oh, bother.
I brought my own pitchfork! Mum said I have to bring it back clean.
Does it cover teeth? My cousin lost two to a goblin.
placed: Right in front of the monsters? You're the king, I suppose.
If I stand very still, maybe they'll think I'm a scarecrow.
Pointy end towards the scary things. Got it.
won: Nobody died! Well, they did, obviously. Terrible day to be them.
Did you see that?! I poked a monster! Wait till I tell the village!
We won! Does this mean I don't have to pay taxes this Tuesday?
lost: Oh dear. Mum is going to be furious about the shirt.
I knew I should have stayed in bed and weeded the leeks.
Tell my wife... the cow needs milking...
levelUp: Blimey! I feel like I've had two breakfasts!
Look at my arms! I could lift a whole sheep!
Am I a knight now? No? Senior Peasant? I'll take it!
ultimate: GET OFF OUR LAND! Well, the king's land!
revived: Whoa! I saw a bright light and a tax collector, so I came back!
Not dead! Take that, mortality!
Still got all my fingers! Seven, eight, nine... ten! Lovely!
lowHp: Excuse me, my insides are trying to become my outsides!
I'm only a hired hand! Stop hitting the hired hand!
Medic! Or a priest! Or a nice cup of broth!

hired: Do not shake my hand unless you enjoy your hair standing on end.
I bring the thunder. The lightning is complimentary.
Apologies in advance to anyone wearing conductive plate mail.
placed: Oh, look how close together they are standing. Delightful.
The air tastes of copper and poor enemy decisions.
Rubber soles on, everyone!
won: Shocking performance! ...Come on, someone laugh.
And that is why you do not bunch up in a thunderstorm!
Does anyone smell ozone? Or burnt eyebrow? That might be mine.
lost: Grounded. In both senses of the word.
A momentary dimming. Do not touch the wizard.
Fizzled out. How deeply anticlimactic.
levelUp: Bigger bolts! Stand back, I am crackling!
I could power a small windmill with my left nostril!
More spark! Less control! Huzzah!
ultimate: CHAIN LIGHTNING! Share and share alike!
revived: Stand clear! Zap! ...Oh good, I sparked myself back.
You cannot earth the storm! Well, you can, briefly.
Fully recharged! Who wants a hug?!
lowHp: Spark low! Glow fading! Send tea!
I am short-circuiting here! Literally!
One more knock and my light goes out!

hired: I was only asking for directions to the bakery. Fine, I'll help.
You lot look like you fall over a lot. Good thing I'm here.
I walk the long road, mostly to avoid employment. Yet here we are.
placed: I shall stand at the back and sigh heavily when you get hit.
Try to get injured in an orderly fashion, please.
Staff ready. Plasters ready. Let us begin.
won: Everyone still has the usual number of limbs. Well done.
Right, who needs a bandage and who just wants attention?
Patchwork complete. Now, about directions to that bakery...
lost: I cannot heal stupid, I am afraid. Nor myself, from the floor.
Well, that road ended in a ditch.
Next time, try dodging. It saves me a fortune in lint.
levelUp: My soothing aura is now aggressively soothing.
Better magic! Fewer scars! Same sensible walking boots!
The road teaches many things. Today it taught me a better stitch.
ultimate: UP YOU GET, YOU GREAT BABIES!
MEND! Before I lose my temper!
revived: Oh, thank you. It is nice to be on the receiving end for once.
Dust off the cloak, walk it off. Just like I tell you lot.
Back on the road. Though the pavement hit rather hard.
lowHp: Um, hello? The healer is bleeding? Is anyone taking notes?
If I fall over, you lot are on your own with the bandages!
Protect the woman with the glowing stick, perhaps?!

hired: Oh, how sweet! You think you are in charge here.
Nine tails, darling. Each one prettier and cleverer than the last.
I shall join you. Your enemies look terribly gullible.
placed: Let us see which of those brutes fancies changing sides today.
Mind the tails! Do you know how long it takes to brush nine of them?
A wink, a smile, and suddenly they are hitting their own friends.
won: They fought so hard for me! A shame they had to lose anyway.
Was that a battle? I barely had to lift a paw.
Such charming foes. Well, they were once I was done with them.
lost: Mud! On my tails! Somebody is going to be cursed into a teapot!
They didn't fall for it! Are they blind, or merely tasteless?!
I am not defeated, I am simply sulking horizontally.
levelUp: More glamorous! More dangerous! Try not to stare.
Another century of wit packed into a single afternoon.
Even the rocks are blushing at me now.
ultimate: HIT YOUR FRIENDS! It will be hilarious!
revived: A fox always has another trick. And another life.
Did you think I was gone? Just powdering my nose.
Right. Whoever mussed my fur is getting bitten by their own best mate.
lowHp: Excuse me! Hitting a lady is exceptionally poor form!
My fur is singed! Do you know what a good comb costs?!
A little help for the adorable fox spirit, please?!

hired: Caw! Sorry, habit. What I meant was: point me at their archers.
Shiny coins! Yes, I shall peck your enemies for shiny coins.
The sky belongs to me. The ground belongs to whoever I drop things on.
placed: I spy with my little eye... a squishy fellow at the back.
Up on the draughts. Down on the daft.
Feathers preened. Beak sharp. Ready to dive.
won: Picked clean! Ooh, has that one got a silver buckle?
Aerial superiority achieved. Also, I found a button.
Their shooters never even looked up. Nobody ever looks up.
lost: Clipped! Grounded! Who threw that rock?!
I did not crash. I landed with excessive enthusiasm.
Molting. I am definitely just molting.
levelUp: Swifter wings! Sharper talons! Louder cawing!
I can spot a nervous crossbowman from three miles up.
The mountain wind is in my feathers!
revived: Back in the air! The ground is filthy anyway.
A ruffle of feathers and I am good as new!
You cannot keep a good crow down!
lowHp: I am losing altitude and feathers at an alarming rate!
Flapping is getting rather difficult here!
Crow down! Crow down! Somebody caw for help!

hired: I meditated on a mountain for forty years. It was very draughty.
Where I point my fan, the gale follows. Hold onto your toupees.
The mountain taught me patience. Also how to shove people off cliffs.
placed: A lovely ledge over there. It would be a shame if someone fell off it.
Feel the breeze? In ten seconds it will be a hurricane.
Do anchor yourselves, friends. It is about to get blustery.
won: Gone with the wind. Quite literally, into that ravine.
A refreshing gale clears the air. And the battlefield.
They lacked proper footing. And spiritual balance. Mostly footing.
lost: The wind changed. Most inconvenient.
Even the ancient pine bends in the storm. I bent right to the dirt.
I shall return to the crags and think about this.
levelUp: From a stiff breeze to a proper tempest!
The mountain spirits approve. Or they are just whistling.
My fan could blow the froth off a pint at fifty paces!
ultimate: GALE OF THE HIGH PEAKS! OFF YOU GO!
HAVE A NICE TRIP! SEE YOU NEXT AUTUMN!
revived: Second wind! ...Yes, that was deliberate.
The storm gathers itself once more!
Breathe deep the mountain air! We are not done!
lowHp: My robe is flapping rather precariously!
A gale reduced to a wheeze... hold fast!
The mountain is eroding! Send mortar!

hired: I am a civilised gentleman. Until I get peckish.
Do not throw sticks. It is demeaning, and I will chase them.
Full moon, half moon, Tuesday afternoon. Any excuse will do.
placed: Is that an orc, or a very loud sausage?
Tell them to run. They taste better when they've had a brisk jog.
Tail tucked. Claws out. Try not to squeak near me.
won: Delicious! Er, I mean, a glorious triumph of arms.
Does anyone have a toothpick? Perhaps a small lance?
Good boy? Who's a good boy? I am. Obviously.
lost: Rolled over. Not for belly rubs, regrettably.
Someone hit me on the nose with a rolled-up scroll!
Playing dead. It is a classic canine strategy.
levelUp: Sharper fangs! Glossier coat! Look at that shine!
The beast within just got a larger flat.
Faster! Hungrier! Hide the livestock!
revived: Hair of the dog that bit me! Well, I am the dog!
Shake it off! From the nose to the tail!
Did someone say walkies?! No? Just war? Fine!
lowHp: Whimpering is entirely tactical, I assure you!
I am leaking claret all over my nice fur!
Cornered wolf! Very dangerous! Also very keen on a healer!

hired: Doors are just walls that haven't been introduced to my forehead yet.
The maze took three years. Then I noticed the walls were plaster.
Point me in a straight line. Turning gives me a headache.
placed: I see a wall of enemies. In a moment, I see a corridor.
Snorting is how I warm up the engine.
Nobody wave anything red. It's a stereotype, and it makes me cross.
won: Like a bull in a... well, a field full of bruised people.
Shortest distance between two points is through that chap's shield.
Anyone got a cloth? Got some helmet stuck on my left horn.
lost: Who put that boulder there?! It wasn't on the map!
Headache. Right between the horns.
Outmanoeuvred. By a slight curve in the road.
levelUp: Thicker skull! Pointier horns! Less regard for masonry!
I feel like I could headbutt a castle into a bungalow!
More beef! More brawn!
ultimate: NO BRAKES ON THE BEEF CART!
revived: Still kicking! With hooves! Watch your shins!
Takes more than that to tenderise me!
Up again! Where did that fellow go? I owe him a horn!
lowHp: Seeing red! Actually, that is blood in my eyes!
I am one blow away from becoming a lovely stew!
Horns heavy... knees wobbly...

hired: I do weddings, wakes, and light skirmishes! Rates are very reasonable.
Nothing makes a knight swing faster than a cheeky jig in D-minor.
Hooves polished, pipes tuned, wine skin full. Let's have a scrap!
placed: Acoustics on this hill are dreadful, but we shall manage.
Tap your toes and swing your axes, everyone!
Taking requests! Except 'The Green Hills of Somewhere Safe'.
won: And for my encore, we shall loot the baggage train!
Music hath charms to soothe the savage breast, or help you thump it.
Pass the hat round! The foes aren't using their coins anymore.
lost: Everyone is a critic! Especially the fellow with the mace!
My reed is split! You cannot play a retreat with a split reed!
Tough crowd. They threw spears instead of roses.
levelUp: Faster tempo! Keep up, you two-legged tortoises!
I just learned a chord that makes people twenty percent angrier!
Look at this breath control! Not even winded!
revived: An intermission! Now for the second act!
You cannot stop the music! Mostly because I am very loud!
Pipes intact! Goat legs operational! Back to the jig!
lowHp: Running out of puff here, friends!
Do not shoot the flautist! It is an unwritten rule!
This tune is rapidly turning into a swan song!

hired: My eyes are up here, darling. Go on, have a proper look.
Notice how the snakes are hissing? That means they like your crown.
I make wonderful garden ornaments out of rude people.
placed: Let me just lift the veil. Ah, fresh air and terrified screaming.
Do tell our allies not to turn around and ask me the time.
The snakes on the left want blood. The ones on the right want a nap.
won: Look at them all. Finest statuary collection in the county.
A bird could perch on that orc now. Lovely posture.
Stone dead. Do pardon the pun, I couldn't resist.
lost: They fought with their eyes shut! That is blatantly cheating!
Bad hair day. Half of them are biting my own ears.
Do not look at me while I am down! Actually, don't look at me at all.
levelUp: A colder stare! And the vipers just shed their skins!
Look at me now! Actually, don't, you're paying my wages.
Turning granite green with envy!
revived: Back on my pedestal! Or tail, rather.
You cannot chip this marble!
Right, the veil stays off permanently now!
lowHp: Even my snakes are looking a bit pale!
Someone is chipping my scales! Rude!
I am hiss-terically close to fainting here!

hired: This banner has been mended nine times. Let us not make it ten.
An army without a banner is merely a violent picnic.
Form ranks! Polish your buckles! Stop slouching, peasant!
placed: Rally to the silk! Within three tiles, ideally. The pole isn't tall.
I shall stand here and project authority. And violence.
Eyes front! Backs straight! Hit them in alphabetical order!
won: Chronicles will be written about this! Mostly by me!
Discipline triumphs over enthusiasm once again.
Note how the banner barely fluttered. Exquisite posture.
lost: A tactical withdrawal! Keep the banner out of the mud!
Nobody heeded my orders! Did anyone listen at all?!
My ten-point plan had a slight flaw around point two.
levelUp: A taller pole! A louder voice! More authority!
I have promoted myself to Supreme Commander of This Hill.
Even my moustache feels more commanding!
ultimate: UNDER THE BANNER, STRIKE AS ONE!
CHARGE! IN A NEAT, STRAIGHT LINE!
revived: The standard never touched the dirt! My face caught it!
As long as the flag flies, the shouting continues!
Regroup! Around me! Immediately!
lowHp: The flagpole is splintering! Also my collarbone!
A commander goes down with his... wait, this isn't a ship.
Hold the line! Because I am currently leaning on it!

hired: I shine so brightly the enemies have to squint. It's a tactical edge.
Virtue, valour, and three coats of silver polish every morning.
Hit my shield! Go on! It actually makes me feel better!
placed: Attention, evildoers! I am pious, shiny, and right in your way!
Form a queue to strike me! There is righteousness enough for all!
Shield up, halo tilted at a jaunty angle.
won: Evil has been smitten! Smote? Smitted? Regardless, it is flat.
Not a smudge on the breastplate. The Light is an excellent detergent.
Did everyone feel uplifted? I felt tremendous.
lost: The Light works in mysterious ways. Today, that way was horizontal.
My armour is tarnished! And my pride is dented!
A temporary test of faith! And ribcages!
levelUp: More radiant! You may wish to wear tinted spectacles!
My righteousness just went up a bracket!
The Light smiles upon me! Or it's glaring off my helmet!
ultimate: EYES ON THE SHINY MAN, SINNERS!
COME AND HIT ME! IT TICKLES!
BY THE LIGHT AND MY OWN MAGNIFICENT CHIN!
revived: Miracle achieved! Do take notes for my biography!
You cannot extinguish the Light! You can only dim it briefly!
Up I rise, gleaming and only mildly concussed!
lowHp: My halo is flickering like a cheap tallow candle!
Even the righteous require the occasional plaster!
The spirit is willing, the plate mail is shaped like a funnel!

hired: I brought bandages, herbal tea, and a tone of mild disappointment.
I will keep you alive, though you will receive a lecture about it.
Do try not to bleed on the vestments. Boil-washing is a chore.
placed: Kettle is on. Try not to lose anything that doesn't grow back.
Now, play nicely, and come back when you've grazed your knees.
Standing at the back with the tweezers and the stern looks.
won: Nobody died, though three of you owe me a thorough explanation.
All mended. Now drink your chamomile before I get cross.
Cleanliness is next to godliness, and this field is a disgrace.
lost: I only have two hands and one teapot! What did you expect?!
You all ran out of range! Every single one of you!
Right. Everyone goes to bed without supper. Including me.
levelUp: Stronger prayers! Hotter tea! Sterner eyebrows!
I can now cleanse curses and grass stains simultaneously!
Blessed with the patience of a saint. Which I sorely need.
ultimate: DEEP BREATHS AND DRINK YOUR TEA!
revived: Well! Thank heavens someone remembered who holds the bandages!
Back on my feet. Who made this mess while I was unconscious?!
A brief lie-down. Now, who has a splinter?
lowHp: Excuse me! Who let the riff-raff into the dispensary?!
I cannot pour from an empty teapot! Help!
If the cleric faints, nobody gets a biscuit after!

hired: I spoke to the trees. They said your castle is blocking their light.
Touch that sapling and I shall have an oak sit on your head.
Nature is peaceful and harmonious. Until it grows thorns and hits you.
placed: Mind the daisies! Stand on the gravel, you armoured clods.
The soil here is lovely. Especially once we fertilise it with foes.
Calling a treant. He's a bit barky before noon.
won: Composted the lot of them. The roses will be thrilled next spring.
My treant would like a word with whoever chipped his bark.
Nature bats last. With a very large branch.
lost: Felled! Like a common pine! The indignity!
I shall lie here and soak up some sun for a bit.
They trampled the petunias! And me!
levelUp: Deeper roots! Sharper briars! More squirrels in my hair!
I am in full bloom! Watch the prickles!
The ancient wood answers! It says 'thump them harder'!
ultimate: ARISE, MR OAK! THEY STEPPED ON THE LAWN!
HUG A TREE! IT HUGS BACK!
revived: Perennial, darling. I always come back in the spring.
Sprouting anew! Get off my leaves!
You forgot to pull up the roots!
lowHp: Wilting! Definitely wilting! Someone water the druid!
My bark is worse than my... no, actually, I am losing bark!
Autumn has arrived rather abruptly for me!

hired: Shirt? Why would I wear a shirt? It only hides the muscles.
Hit me first! I don't wake up properly until my nose is bleeding!
Wages in beef, please. Gold is terrible for the teeth.
placed: Point me at the biggest one! I'll hit the second biggest with him!
Brrr! Bit nippy out! Better start swinging to warm up!
No plan! Plans are for people with small axes!
won: IS ANYONE LEFT?! WHAT ABOUT THAT BUSH?! IT LOOKED AT ME FUNNY!
Hah! Barely broke a sweat! Broke three ribs, mind, but not a sweat!
Who has the roast leg of Anything?! I am starving!
lost: Call it a draw! Now come back here so I can bite your kneecaps!
The ground hit me from behind! Cowardly dirt!
Nap time! Wake me when my blood is back inside!
levelUp: VEINS POPPING! AXE HEAVIER! VOCABULARY SMALLER!
I AM NOW TOO ANGRY TO FEEL MY OWN TOES!
BIGGER! LOUDER! MORE SHOUTING!
ultimate: TOO ANGRY TO DIE! TOO DAFT TO STOP!
revived: WASN'T DEAD! JUST LOOKING FOR MY OTHER AXE ON THE FLOOR!
MY TURN AGAIN! HAHA!
YOU ONLY MADE ME CROSSER!
lowHp: FINALLY, A PROPER SCRAP! NOW I HAVE THEM RIGHT WHERE I WANT THEM!
BLEEDING MEANS IT'S WORKING!
HIT ME ONE MORE TIME, SEE WHAT HAPPENS! ...Actually, wait, don't!

hired: Watch your step. I have already laid four snares in your throne room.
People are noisy. Trees are quiet. Foes in traps: noisy, then quiet.
Keep the clanking knights away from me. They scare the game.
placed: Little steel surprise under the fern. Do not tell the enemy.
Camouflaged and cross. My natural state.
Step right there, you big ugly brute. Just one more inch...
won: Snap, thwack, thud. The music of the forest.
Like shooting fish in a barrel. If the fish had ankles in bear traps.
I need to collect my snares before the goat eats them.
lost: I stepped in my own snare! Who moved that bush?!
Flushed from cover. Deeply unprofessional.
Tracked, cornered, and thumped. I am never living this down.
levelUp: Heavier springs on the traps! Quieter boots on the feet!
I could track a ghost across a gravel drive.
Sharper eyes. Meaner iron.
ultimate: WELCOME TO THE KILLING FLOOR! MIND THE FERNS!
revived: Played possum. Worked a treat, didn't it?
Back in the brush. Nobody saw a thing.
Right, resetting the traps. And my collarbone.
lowHp: Cover is blown! Along with half my cloak!
I am a sniper, not a punching bag!
Need a bush to hide in! Immediately!

hired: My patron says hello, and asks if you are currently using your soul.
I didn't read the small print on the pact, and frankly, why start now?
Dark magic is perfectly safe! For me. Less so for those fellows.
placed: Whose life force looks the most nutritious today?
Do ignore the ominous chanting and the smell of sulphur.
Clause four, paragraph two: they burn, I get a lovely glow.
won: Delicious! Tastes like despair and slightly burnt pork.
My patron is pleased! My skin has never looked clearer!
Another successful transaction. Sign here to confirm your defeat.
lost: Breach of contract! I was promised unlimited eldritch might!
Hold on, I must consult my notary in the ninth circle...
Defaulted on the loan. The interest is going to be dreadful.
levelUp: I just initialled an addendum! Look at the size of these hexes!
More forbidden knowledge! Mostly about how to make people itch!
The abyss stared back, and offered me a discount!
ultimate: SIGN IN BLOOD! OR JUST BLEED!
revived: My patron refused my resignation! I live!
Loophole in clause seven! You cannot kill me on a Tuesday!
Back from the void! The singing down there was atrocious.
lowHp: I need a top-up! Stand still and let me hex you!
My aura is looking distinctly beige!
The shadows are getting a bit too familiar!

hired: Hire one, get three free! Note: two of us are made of light and lies.
Are you speaking to me, or the me standing two feet to the left?
Reality is merely a suggestion I choose to ignore.
placed: One here, one there, and the real me having a biscuit at the back.
Let us see how hard they can hit a reflection.
Mirrors polished. Smoke primed. Ego inflated.
won: They spent twenty minutes duelling a reflection. Priceless.
A standing ovation from all four of me!
Now you see me, now you're unconscious.
lost: They guessed the right one! One in three chance, honestly!
That wasn't me falling over! It was... performance art!
My decoys downed tools and left me to take the hit!
levelUp: Finer decoys! Now with convincing banter!
Even I am not entirely sure which one of me is real anymore!
More smoke! Larger mirrors!
ultimate: WHICH ONE OF US IS HOLDING THE KNIFE?!
EYES ON THE LADY! ALL SIX OF HER!
revived: Aha! You only killed my stunt double!
Presto! Back in the room! Did you miss me?
A cheap trick? Darling, that trick cost a whole heart.
lowHp: My illusions are flickering! And so is my consciousness!
Stop hitting the solid one! Hit the sparkly ones!
I need a distraction! Look, a three-headed goat!

hired: Bows are charming. If you enjoy living in the twelfth century.
One bullet, three foes in a row. I do love a bargain.
Earplugs in, darlings. This thing barks.
placed: Line them up nicely for me. Powder isn't cheap.
Sighting down the barrel... mind your plumed helmets in front.
Deep breath. Slow squeeze. Big bang.
won: Blow the smoke off the barrel. Pose dramatically. Collect pay.
Right between the eyes, and the eyes of the two blokes behind him.
And that is why we invented gunpowder.
lost: Misfire! Damp powder! Sun in my eyes! Pick one!
Caught me mid-reload. Deeply unsporting.
Do not scratch the stock! It is walnut!
levelUp: Rifled barrel! Heavier grain! Louder bang!
I could shoot the pip out of an apple through a keyhole.
Steady hand, colder eye.
ultimate: HIGH NOON! GIVE OR TAKE FOUR HOURS!
LINE THEM UP AND KNOCK THEM DOWN!
revived: Reloaded and back in the saddle!
Ricochet! Didn't even pierce the duster!
Right. The safety is officially off.
lowHp: Spitting blood and chewing lead here!
They are in pistol-whipping range! I hate pistol-whipping!
Need cover to reload! And possibly a surgeon!

hired: Hrrngh. Does this job... hrrngh... include spare elbows?
I used to be somebody. Hrrngh. Now I am mostly damp.
Hrrngh. Point me at the living. I want to sneeze on them.
placed: Standing here. Hrrngh. Rotting quietly.
If my ear falls off... hrrngh... pop it in a bucket.
Hrrngh. Ready to shamble. At a brisk one mile per hour.
won: Hrrngh. We won? Good. I found a nice kneecap.
Nothing a bit of twine... hrrngh... won't hold together.
They stopped moving. Hrrngh. Will they get up like me? No? Shame.
lost: Hrrngh. In a heap. Somebody fetch a shovel.
Back in the dirt. Hrrngh. At least the worms are friendly.
Lost a leg. Hrrngh. And the argument.
levelUp: Hrrngh! Less squishy! More festering!
Promoted from 'mildew' to 'proper rot'! Hrrngh!
My jaw stays on when I shout now! Hrrngh!
ultimate: BITS OF ME ON ALL OF YOU! HRRNGH!
revived: Hrrngh. Again? You really get your money's worth out of a corpse.
Stitched back up! Hrrngh! Think my left foot is on backwards.
Rising from the grave! Hrrngh! Twice in one week!
lowHp: Hrrngh... down to my last three ribs...
Mostly held together by moss and optimism now... hrrngh...
If anyone has some glue... hrrngh... now would be the time.

hired: STEAM PRESSURE: OPTIMAL. MORAL COMPASS: NOT INSTALLED.
GREETINGS, FLESH KING. POINT ME AT THE UNINVITED GUESTS.
AMMUNITION: LOADED. TEA URN IN CHEST CAVITY: BOILING.
placed: TRIPOD DEPLOYED. PLEASE DO NOT LEAN ON THE AUTOMATON.
SCANNING FIELD... LOCATED SEVERAL TARGETS WITH POOR POSTURE.
FIRING SOLUTION CALCULATED. BY WHICH I MEAN: SHOOT EVERYTHING.
won: HOSTILES: PERFORATED. BARREL TEMPERATURE: TOASTY.
VICTORY ACHIEVED. DISPENSING CELEBRATORY WHISTLE: TOOT.
ZERO JAMS. ZERO REMORSE. ONE SLIGHT SQUEAK IN LEFT HIP.
lost: CRITICAL FAILURE: MY INSIDES ARE NOW OUTSIDE.
PRESSURE LOSS DETECTED. HISSING SADLY.
GUARANTEE VOIDED BY LARGE BLUNT INSTRUMENT.
levelUp: NEW COGS FITTED: NOW SHOOTS TWENTY PERCENT MORE RUDELY.
GEARS OILED. SIGHTS CALIBRATED. ANNOYANCE OUTPUT DOUBLED.
REFITTING COMPLETE. I HAVE ACHIEVED HIGHER CALIBRE.
ultimate: SUPPRESSING FIRE! AND ALSO REGULAR FIRE!
EMPTYING MAGAZINE! RELOADING IS FOR COWARDS!
revived: HAVE YOU TRIED WINDING ME UP AGAIN? YES. THANK YOU.
BOILER RELIT. GRUDGE DATABASE RESTORED.
SPRINGS RE-WOUND. WHO DENTED MY CHASSIS?!
lowHp: WARNING: LEAKING STEAM AND VERY IMPORTANT SPRINGS!
STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY AT TWELVE PERCENT! SEND A SPANNER!
CLANKING OMINOUSLY! THIS IS NOT A GOOD CLANK!

hired: Rates: grunts standard, bosses double, mud on my boots triple.
Loyalty is priceless. Which is why I charge by the hour instead.
Point out their highest earner. I like a target with deep pockets.
placed: I see the big one. He looks like a walking bounty.
Clock is ticking, majesty. Let's make this profitable.
Blades sharp. Ledger open.
won: Target eliminated. I have already itemised the expenses.
Pleasure doing business. Do tell the tavern I was good.
Bagged the big one. Keep the change. Actually, no, give me the change.
lost: Hazard pay! I am invoking the hazard pay clause!
This wasn't in the terms! My paymaster will hear about this!
I cannot spend gold if I am dead. This is terrible financial planning.
levelUp: My fee just went up by fifteen percent.
Sharper daggers, higher fee.
Invested in myself. The returns are lethal.
revived: Extra shift! That's double pay, majesty!
Back on the books! Let us settle that tab!
Nobody stiffs me on a contract and walks away!
lowHp: The profit-to-blood-loss ratio is looking distinctly poor!
My value is dropping rapidly here!
Heal the contractor! I'm not covered for this!

hired: Four millennia in a sarcophagus gives one a crick in the neck.
Do not pull the loose thread. I will unravel to the ankles.
I was a pharaoh once. Or an accountant. The hieroglyphs smudged.
placed: Keep the fire wizard away from me. I am ninety percent dry linen.
Let us wrap this up quickly. ...Nobody appreciates classic humour.
Dusty, grumpy, and ready to entangle.
won: All tied up in neat little bows. Just like home.
And stay down! Do you know how hard it is to iron these bandages?
Preserved my unbeaten streak. Mostly with natron and spite.
lost: Unwound. Literally and emotionally.
I am going back to my pyramid. At least it was quiet.
Someone stepped on my trailing bandage! Now I'm half naked!
levelUp: Higher thread count! Egyptian cotton, darling!
An older curse! A tighter wrap!
I feel at least three dynasties younger!
revived: Just needed to tuck my spleen back in and rewind the gauze!
You cannot kill what has already been pickled in jars!
The tomb could not hold me! Nor could that puddle!
lowHp: Running dangerously low on linen here!
A breeze could blow me apart! Somebody fetch a needle and thread!
My wrappings are in tatters! Avert your eyes!

hired: No sea for three hundred miles? Fine, we shall pirate the shrubbery!
Like the hat? An admiral no longer needed his head.
Grappling hook polished, cutlass keen, rum regrettably empty.
placed: That archer at the back looks lonely. I shall reel him in for a chat.
Avast! Which means 'look at me, I am fabulous'.
Wait till they find out my hook has a thirty-foot rope on it.
won: Boarded, looted, and my hat didn't even tilt!
Check their boots for gold teeth! What? It's a pirate thing.
All ashore that's going ashore! Specifically, face-down in the mud.
lost: Keelhauled! On dry grass! How does that even work?!
Don't touch the feather in the hat! It's ostrich!
Scuttled. Right in the middle of a meadow.
levelUp: Promoted from Buccaneer to Swashbuckler! More buckle per swash!
Longer rope! Shinier hook! Jauntier swagger!
Yarr! ...Sorry, felt required to say it at least once.
ultimate: GET OVER HERE, YOU SCURVY SHOOTER!
revived: Washed ashore and ready to brawl!
Takes more than a knock to sink this frigate!
Hat's still on! That means it didn't count!
lowHp: Taking on water! Well, losing blood! Same difference!
My timbers are thoroughly shivered here!
Need a tot of rum and a very large bandage!

hired: My lute is out of tune, and my backing singers eat raw squirrels.
A dirge to depress the enemy, a jig to invigorate the lads!
The wolves howl in F-sharp. I play in C. We call it modern.
placed: Testing, testing... one, two, awoooo.
Prepare for a ballad so mournful the enemy's knees go weak.
Acoustics are decent. Wolves, on my count: three, four...
won: Thank you! We are the Howling Minstrels! Songbooks at the back!
Wait till I rhyme 'massacre' with 'haberdasher' in the third verse.
Critics raved! The enemies collapsed! Literally!
lost: They smashed my lute! Do you know what spruce costs in a warzone?!
The wolves are howling in actual sadness now.
Creative differences with a very large axe.
levelUp: New strings! Catgut. Do not ask the cat!
Louder chorus! Now with three-part canine harmony!
My dirge is now legally classified as a sedative!
ultimate: SING ALONG IF YOU KNOW THE WORDS! AWOOO!
THE BALLAD OF YOUR IMMINENT DEFEAT!
revived: Encore! You demanded it, so here I am!
Tuned the lute while I was dead. Sounds much brighter!
The show must go on! Even if the singer is slightly bruised!
lowHp: My voice is cracking! And so are my ribs!
Playing a very sad solo on a very small violin!
Protect the artist! The wolves cannot play chords!

hired: My wolves are house-trained. Outside the house, it is a free-for-all.
I whistle, they bite. It is a wonderfully simple method.
Do not pet Brutus. He considers fingers hors d'oeuvres.
placed: Who wants a marrow bone? Look, that orc has twenty of them!
Whip in the right hand, dog biscuits in the left.
Heel, boys. Wait for the horn. Then chew.
won: Good boys! Drop the shinbone, Brutus, you don't know where it's been.
Pack mentality beats military strategy every time.
Treats all round! And a brush for the coats.
lost: The pack scattered! Someone threw a steak in the bushes!
Tangled in my own whip. How terribly amateur.
Down, boy... no, I mean me, I am down.
levelUp: Louder whistle! Bigger wolves! Fewer intact enemy trousers!
Alpha of the pack! Even the goat respects me slightly!
More bite, less bark!
revived: The wolves licked my face until I woke up! Gross, yet effective!
Alpha is back on her feet! Whistle ready!
Right, who kicked my dog?!
lowHp: If I drop, nobody knows which pocket the biscuits are in!
My whip arm is flagging!
Call the pack back! Mother needs a shield!

hired: Swallowed by a kraken for three weeks. Great listener, dreadful decor.
I smell of brine, kelp, and unresolved nautical trauma.
Need the enemy closer? I carry my own high tide.
placed: Bit dry round here. Let me summon three thousand gallons of seawater.
Mind the barnacles on my boots. They nip.
The undertow is hungry today.
won: Washed away like sandcastles! Did anyone find a crab in the puddle?
Nothing beats a refreshing dip in the abyssal trench!
High tide, low survival rate.
lost: Beached! Like a particularly damp flounder!
Dry land is overrated anyway. Too hard when you fall on it.
Back to Davy Jones' locker. Tell him I have his jumper.
levelUp: More tentacles! Don't ask where they come from, I certainly don't!
A stronger rip-tide! Hold onto your anchors!
Smelling forty percent more maritime!
ultimate: RELEASE THE... WELL, PART OF THE KRAKEN!
UNDERTOW! COME GIVE US A HUG!
revived: Spat out again! Even death finds me too salty!
Breathe the bilge water and get back up!
Tide's coming back in, lads!
lowHp: Drying out here! Somebody splash me with a bucket!
Leaking seawater and blood in equal measure!
Sinking fast! Man the lifeboats!

hired: My horse has a pedigree longer than yours, majesty. Do not offend him.
Twelve feet of ash and steel at a brisk gallop. Maths does the rest.
The secret to lancing is pointing the sharp bit away from yourself.
placed: A nice clear lane! Oh, how thoughtful of them to queue up.
Steady, Buttercup. We trample them on the signal.
Visor down, chin up, stirrups polished.
won: Like threading a needle! A very loud, screaming needle!
Buttercup didn't even ruin his shoes. Good horse.
Through the front, out the back, home for oats.
lost: Unhorsed! Do you know how far down the ground is from up there?!
Snapped my good lance! That was imported ash!
Buttercup has trotted off to eat clover. Traitor.
levelUp: Streamlined plume! Faster horse! Pointier stick!
We have achieved ramming speed!
Cantering with extreme prejudice!
ultimate: TALLY-HO AND OUT OF THE WAY!
COMING THROUGH! DO NOT STOP TO WAVE!
revived: Back in the stirrups! Who caught the horse?!
A mere tumble at the jumps! Back to the gallop!
Fresh lance! Second wind! Let us try that jump again!
lowHp: My armour is rattling like a bag of spanners!
Whoa, boy! My ribs cannot take the trotting!
Need a farrier and a medic! In either order!

hired: I do not kill people. I finalise the paperwork once you have.
Night shift for three thousand years. The pay is dreadful, though.
Do not fear the Reaper. Unless your health bar is looking a bit thin.
placed: Let me check my ledger... ah yes, several appointments here today.
Hovering menacingly. It really saves wear and tear on the shoes.
Tick, tock, darlings. The scythe is freshly whetted.
won: All filed, stamped, and dispatched. Anyone want a receipt?
A busy afternoon, but we cleared the backlog.
Neat work. Barely got any ectoplasm on the hem.
lost: How does one kill Death? Honestly, the bureaucracy of this place...
Knocking off early. My hood is in a twist.
I shall have to write myself into the ledger. Embarrassing.
levelUp: Longer reach on the scythe! Shorter queues for the clients!
Promoted to Senior Regional Reaper!
Cold as the grave, twice as efficient!
ultimate: YOUR NUMBER IS UP! SPECIFICALLY, NUMBER ZERO!
revived: Professional courtesy from the afterlife. I'm back.
You cannot fire me! I have tenure!
Scythe retrieved. Let us count the survivors.
lowHp: I am dangerously close to becoming my own client!
My cloak is more hole than spook at this point!
A little vitality for the avatar of mortality, please?!

hired: Thank you for hiring me tomorrow. Yesterday was a blast.
Age before beauty? Darling, I have an hourglass. Both and neither.
Your enemies are moving at a glacial pace. I made sure of it.
placed: Let's put them on half-speed and us on double-quick.
Wait for it... wait for it... three seconds ago!
A prophecy: we win this one in about forty seconds.
won: Right on time. Give or take a century.
They were simply too slow for the current century.
I loved the bit where we won. Even better the second time round.
lost: Paradox! That was definitely a timeline error!
Give me five minutes to rewind twenty minutes...
Out of time. Which, given my job description, is deeply ironic.
levelUp: Finer sand in the hourglass! Smoother temporal distortion!
I just borrowed some experience from next Thursday!
Ageing like a fine wine, backwards!
ultimate: STOP THE CLOCKS! HASTE THE HEROES!
HALF SPEED FOR YOU! DOUBLE FOR US!
revived: Rewound that fatal blow! Never happened! Didn't see a thing!
Back from five minutes ago! Healthier times!
Déjà vu, darlings! Let's try that without me falling over!
lowHp: My sand is running out at an alarming rate!
Could someone pause the large fellow with the club?!
Living on borrowed time here! Literally!

hired: Part man, part clockwork, part thunderstorm. All extremely loud.
I blink into the enemy's midst and explode. Lovely to meet people.
Do not oil my joints with butter. It smells like scones.
placed: Coils humming. Crowd identified.
Now you see me here. In a blink, you smell scorched orc.
Sword charged to four hundred thunderclaps. Mind the hilt.
won: Clean blink, cleaner discharge. Not a hair out of place.
They never worked out where I was standing. Neither did I, briefly.
Smells of ozone and triumph.
lost: Teleported straight into a club. Geometry is a harsh mistress.
Short-circuited! Somebody fetch a dry towel and a screwdriver!
I blinked straight onto the floor. Not ideal.
levelUp: Copper coils swapped for gold! Look at that conductivity!
Faster blink! Bigger bang! Shinier sword!
Wound tight and overly confident!
revived: Struck myself back to life! Built-in feature!
The knot of fate untangled! I am upright again!
Spare spring engaged! Let's spark!
lowHp: Core flickering! Sparks coming from the wrong places!
If I blink right now I might leave my spleen behind!
Running low! Somebody strike me with lightning!

hired: Drowned in the North Sea, hanged in Port Royal, bored in both.
I bring ghostly cannons. No, I don't know where they float from.
Kill me once, shame on you. Kill me twice, well, that actually works.
placed: Run out the invisible guns, lads! Target that hillside!
Barnacles on my coat, gunpowder in my beard, spite in my heart.
Let them cut me down! It only makes me angry and slightly greener!
won: A full broadside in a pasture! That confused the cows no end!
Still standing! Didn't even need my spare life today!
All hands on deck! Now, where's the tavern?
lost: Died twice in five minutes. That is just careless.
Sunk! Twice! The funeral costs are going to be astronomical.
Back to the locker. Don't wait up.
levelUp: Heavier cannonballs! Spookier beard! Better hat!
Promoted to Dread Admiral of This Particular Field!
More powder in the kegs!
ultimate: FIRE ALL GUNS! YES, THE INVISIBLE ONES!
revived: Told you drowning didn't stick! Why would a sword?!
Back from the briny deep! Again!
Round two, landlubbers! I have plenty of ghosts left!
lowHp: Hull breached! Bilge pumps failing!
One foot in the grave, the other on a banana skin!
About to use my spare life here, heads up!

hired: ORDER ONE: FLATTEN CASTLES. ORDER TWO: FLATTEN CASTLE-SHAPED THINGS.
CALIBRATING MORTAR. STAND CLEAR OF THE BACKBLAST AND THE SARCASM.
HEAVY ARTILLERY READY. SUBTLETY COG NOT FOUND.
placed: ANCHORING FEET. PREPARING TO LOB LARGE EXPLOSIVE VEGETABLES.
TARGETING ENEMY CLUSTER. THEY LOOK LIKE A WALL IF I SQUINT.
TRAJECTORY: HIGH. COLLATERAL DAMAGE: ENTHUSIASTIC.
won: ALL WALLS REMOVED. ALSO SEVERAL FOES WHO STOOD NEAR WALLS.
CRATER GENERATION: COMPLETE. HAVE A PLEASANT DAY.
SHELLS EXPENDED. BARREL SMOKING. JOB DONE.
lost: MORTAR TUBE OBSTRUCTED BY MY OWN FACE.
STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE. I HAVE BECOME THE RUBBLE.
BOILER PUNCTURED. MAKING SAD KETTLE NOISES.
levelUp: HIGHER EXPLOSIVE YIELD! LOUDER BOOM! HAPPIER MACHINE!
RANGE EXTENDED. NO SHRUBBERY IS SAFE.
ARMOUR PLATING THICKENED BY THREE INCHES OF CAST IRON.
revived: CRANE APPLIED. SIEGE BOT VERTICAL ONCE MORE.
REIGNITING FURNACE. RECALCULATING GRUDGES.
BACK IN ACTION. PREPARING RETALIATORY SHELLING.
lowHp: WARNING: AMMUNITION HOPPER IS ON FIRE!
LEAKING OIL AND DIGNITY!
REQUIRING IMMEDIATE PERCUSSIVE MAINTENANCE!

hired: Do not touch the halo. It is pure divine grace, and very hot.
The Cleric brings tea. I bring miracles. Know the difference.
I shall keep you alive, provided you maintain an aesthetic formation.
placed: Stand within the golden glow if you like your organs where they are.
Radiating serenity. And a solid four-inch wall of light.
Prayers prepared. Vestments immaculate.
won: Blessed are the victorious, for they need not clean their own boots.
The heavens smiled upon us. Mostly because my posture was impeccable.
Not a scratch on the faithful. Well, a few, but I buffed them out.
lost: The shield cracked! What were they hitting us with, sin?!
Even divine grace has a weight limit, apparently.
I shall retreat to the chapel and write a strongly worded hymn.
levelUp: Brighter halo! Wider shield! More serene condescension!
Favoured by the heavens! You can tell by the glow!
Miracles now dispensed at twice the volume!
ultimate: BY THE RADIANT HALO, BE MENDED!
revived: Went up, looked around, decided you lot couldn't manage without me.
Divine intervention! On my own behalf!
Halo straightened. Let us try that with more faith this time.
lowHp: My sanctuary is being severely tested right now!
Grace is eternal. My health, decidedly finite!
Guards! The High Priestess is being jostled!

hired: Down, Barnaby! That is the king, not a snack! ...Hello, majesty.
I ride a fire-breathing wyvern. Your stable boy just fainted.
We require double rations: one steak for me, three cows for the mount.
placed: Looking down on everyone comes naturally when you're thirty feet up.
They've lined up in a neat row! Barnaby, clear your throat!
Wings spread, lance couched, crown pinned on tight.
won: Well roasted! Medium-rare at the front, well-done at the back!
Good wyvern! Don't eat the helmets, they give you indigestion.
Queen of the skies, empress of the battlefield.
lost: Shot from the sky! Do you know how hard it is to land in plate?!
Barnaby got hiccups mid-strafe! Singed my own cape!
Grounded. Say 'clipped wings' and I'll feed you to the lizard.
levelUp: Hotter breath! Sharper scales! Shinier crown!
Barnaby just grew another two feet! We'll need a bigger stable!
Supreme aerial majesty achieved!
ultimate: FIRE IN THE HOLE! WELL, TRENCH!
revived: Back in the saddle! Flap harder, you oversized newt!
You cannot keep royalty on the turf for long!
Crown unbent! Wyvern annoyed! Watch out below!
lowHp: Taking arrows! Barnaby is losing scales!
Smoke in my visor! Possibly my own!
Need a soft landing and a cleric!

hired: I am seven tons of enchanted masonry. Do reinforce your floors.
I do not dodge. 'Out of the way' is for other people.
When I stamp, the enemy stops to reconsider their career choices.
placed: Planted. I am now part of the local geography.
Come, break your little toothpicks against my chest.
Standing still at maximum velocity.
won: They hit me forty times. I hit the ground once. I won.
Is the battle over? I thought someone was knocking at my door.
Unmoved. Unbothered. Slightly dusty.
lost: TIMBERRRRR. ...Oh dear, someone fetch a pulley.
I have fallen, and I require six masons and a mule team to get up.
Cracked down the middle. Moisture must have got into the mortar.
levelUp: Added another layer of granite! And a lovely gargoyle on the shoulder!
Heavier! Wider! More seismic!
The earth shakes when I sneeze now!
ultimate: STOP MOVING AND LISTEN TO THE FLOOR!
revived: Rebuilt! With better mortar this time!
The wall stands again! Mind your toes!
Stacked my bricks back up! Who threw that pebble?!
lowHp: Chipping away at me! I am down to the rubble core!
Cracks in the shoulders that hold up the roof!
Need a trowel and some magic mortar here!

hired: I have consulted the stars. They said 'move two tiles left and duck'.
Knowledge is power: the kind that drops stars on three crowds.
Do not touch my beard. Three scrolls and an astrolabe are lost in it.
placed: By my calculations, their chance of survival is... laughable.
Aligning the stars. And topping up skill meters, as a favour.
The cosmos is vast, cold, and about to land on that orc's head.
won: Q.E.D. Quite Easily Destroyed.
Just as I predicted in chapter four of my memoirs.
A triumph of intellect over brute force. Well, and falling stars.
lost: I forgot to carry the two! A rounding error! A mere slip of the quill!
Mercury was in retrograde! Nobody can fight in retrograde!
My spectacles are cracked! Who hits a senior academic?!
levelUp: Eureka! I have discovered a bigger star to drop!
Studied and promoted! Look at the size of this hat!
Infinite cosmic wisdom! Still can't find my other slipper!
ultimate: STARS FALL! METERS FILL! MATHS WINS!
revived: A minor erratum in the text! Corrected and upright!
You cannot silence tenure!
Recalculated my mortality! Turns out I'm fine!
lowHp: My scholarly robes offer no armour at all!
I am a thinker, not a tank! Somebody tank!
Seeing stars! And not the helpful astronomical kind!

hired: Ignore the sword whispering about blood. It's only peckish.
Two for one: a master swordsman and a very rude cursed blade.
Yes, my eyes are glowing red. No, I do not need a poultice.
placed: Hush, you. You'll get fed as soon as the horn blows.
The longer this takes, the less polite the sword becomes.
Hand on the hilt. Sanity on a very thin leash.
won: The blade is full. It's actually purring. Weird, isn't it?
Still me holding it! Mostly! Seventy percent sure it's me!
Cut them down, drank the vigour, ruined my cuffs. Standard Tuesday.
lost: The sword is blaming me. I am blaming the sword. We aren't speaking.
Overdrawn on the blood bank. Embarrassing.
Even the demon wants to go home and lie down.
levelUp: The sword grew extra teeth! Wait, swords shouldn't have teeth...
Stronger! Darker! The gloomiest fellow in the tavern!
We have reached an agreement: we hit things harder!
revived: The demon refused to let me die before pudding!
Too cursed to quit! Too spiteful to stay down!
We're back! And both of us are furious!
lowHp: If I don't hit someone soon, the sword starts eating my own arm!
Running on fumes and demonic spite here!
Need a target to drain, or a priest who doesn't mind cursed iron!

hired: Two kings in one castle? You do the paperwork. I shall do the smiting.
I am not 'bossy'. I am sovereign. There is a legal distinction.
All in favour of me joining? Irrelevant, it is not a democracy.
placed: I hereby annex this tile and all adjacent tiles in perpetuity.
Look at them, standing on my lawn without leave.
The court is in session. I am judge, jury and lightning-thrower.
won: Guilty of treason against my personal space! Sentence carried out!
You may now kiss the ring. Wipe your mouth first, peasant.
Order is restored. My order, specifically.
lost: Usurped! By common rabble! I demand a recount!
I am not defeated, I am in temporary exile on the floor!
Treason! Every single blow was high treason!
levelUp: Promoted from Tyrant to Supreme Autocrat! Bow lower!
Heavier sceptre! Taller crown! Fewer rights for the enemy!
My decree is now thirty percent louder!
ultimate: KNEEL BEFORE THE REIGN! ALL OF YOU!
revived: Long live me! Again!
The dynasty continues! Right where it left off!
Did you think a mere fatal wound could dethrone me?!
lowHp: Assassination attempt in progress! Guards! Where are my guards?!
Royal blood is being spilled! Surely that is a hanging offence!
My reign is looking perilously brief right now!

samurai: Breakfast before honour, surely. Honour gives terrible heartburn.
My blade has no name. It needs none.
Mine is called 'Percival'. It insists on being introduced first.
The wind carries the scent of steel.
And your socks. Mostly your socks, if we are being frank.
One strike to settle all accounts.
Provided the invoice is clearly itemised.
A true warrior seeks neither praise nor gold.
Which works out nicely, as the king pays neither.
mystic: The weave is trembling with ancient power.
That was my lunch, I assure you. Turnip stew.
I foresee a dark shadow across this field.
That is the wyvern, friend. Look up occasionally.
Spirits murmur in the corners of my mind.
Tell them visiting hours ended at four.
The celestial alignment is deeply troubling.
Everything troubles you. Last Tuesday it was cloudy tea.
Magic flows like an underground river.
And leaks through the roof just as badly.
yokai: The old lanterns flicker with restless souls.
Probably just a draught from the pantry.
Can you hear the spirit parade approaching?
I hear a badger having a dispute in a hedge.
Quiet. The one with the crown is listening.
Nine hundred years of wandering between worlds.
And still you cannot find a matching pair of sandals.
We dance between twilight and mischief.
Mind the ditch. Mischief carries no healer.
knightly: Shield high, brother! For queen and country!
Right you are! And do straighten your plume, it looks drunken.
Our oaths are forged in sacred steel.
And our joints are rusting in this miserable drizzle.
A knight knows neither retreat nor fear.
A knight also appreciates a dry pair of trousers.
To the front! Let righteousness guide your tip!
Right behind you. About six sensible paces behind you.
We stand shoulder to shoulder, unbreakable!
Could you nudge left an inch? Your pauldron is in my ear.
guardian: Please move it. You are blocking the view and all the air.
No harm shall pass this bulwark.
A pigeon just flew right past your nose.
Stand behind me! I am solid granite!
You are six stone of gristle in dented tin. But thank you.
They will break upon us like waves upon the shore.
Waves usually erode the shore over time, you know.
Oaks drop acorns on people. Please do not drop anything on me.
blade: My edge could slice a falling whisper in half.
Mine is slightly chipped, but has immense sentimental value.
Steel meets steel, and only truth remains.
Truth, and a terrible lot of sparks in the grass.
A clean cut is the highest courtesy.
I prefer a very messy parry followed by running away.
The sword is an extension of the soul.
Mine appears to be an extension of a blacksmith's bad mood.
Did you see that parry? Poetry in motion.
Looked more like a flustered windmill to me, mate.
marksman: Three tiles left, wind blowing northwest.
I already shot him while you were licking your finger.
Never shoot until you see the whites of their eyes.
I am farsighted. I shoot when they look like blurry pears.
My bowstring hums the song of quiet exits.
My bowstring snapped last Tuesday. Using hemp twine now.
High crags make every arrow count for three.
And make tumbling down the hill three times as painful.
I just close one eye and hope the king is watching.
caster: The incantation requires absolute phonetic precision.
I usually just shout 'KABOOM' and duck.
Fire or frost? The eternal dilemma.
Whatever does not singe my sensible woollen cuffs.
Feel the raw ether crackling in the air!
That is static from the goat rubbing against your robes.
My spells are approved by three councils and mathematically sound.
The burnt turf over there strongly disagrees.
Stand back, I am about to channel the infinite.
If you set my cloak on fire again, infinite or not, you owe me.
holy: And upon whoever packed the lemon shortbread.
The Light shines upon the humble.
It is currently shining right into my eyes. Very glaring.
Let our prayers rise like morning incense.
Incense gives the paladin a runny nose. Speak softly.
Grace will preserve us through the darkest trial.
Grace, and three layers of boiled leather under the tunic.
No evil can withstand our sacred conviction.
A large club seems to test the theory rather severely.
wild: Smell that? Pine needles, rain, and imminent danger.
Mostly wet dog and your uncle's cabbage soup.
The wild needs no walls, no crowns, no kings.
The king is standing right there. Lower your voice.
Listen to the ravens. They know what comes.
The ravens want breadcrumbs, you mystical romantic.
We run with the pack, free and fierce!
I am walking. Running makes my knees click like castanets.
The earth provides all a hunter requires.
Except dry socks and a decent cup of tea.
arcane: The dimensional rift is widening by three cubits.
Put a rug over it before someone trips.
I have unbound the seventh seal of chronomancy.
Could you unbind the latch on the biscuit tin instead?
Reality is remarkably malleable this afternoon.
Indeed. My left boot appears to be phasing through the dirt.
The runes are speaking of doom and ruin.
The runes need to cheer up and find a hobby.
Careful with that orb. It holds condensed paradox.
Dropped it twice this morning. Just bounces, honestly.
frontier: Say it again. Go on, complete the cliché.
Out past the border, a man learns what he is made of.
Mostly gristle, cheap beer, and bad decisions.
Never trust a horizon that does not show smoke.
Never trust a ranger who cooks without salt.
Keep your powder dry and your eyes on the ridge.
And your hand on your purse when the rogue walks by.
A campfire, a bedroll, and no tax collectors.
Until Thursday. They ride faster than the wolves.
warden: I shall keep watch from midnight until dawn.
You said that yesterday and woke up face-down in a clover patch.
Nothing enters this wood without my leave.
Three goblins and a stray mule passed while you sneezed.
The ancient trees whisper warnings in the night.
They are complaining about the damp, same as everyone else.
My shield has guarded the northern border for an age.
Explains why the woodworm has settled in so nicely.
Vigilance is a virtue that never sleeps.
Vigilance is going to have terrible bags under its eyes tomorrow.
trickster: If it is the four of spades with your face on it again, I am leaving.
Which one of us is the genuine illusion?
Neither. We are both figments of the king's heatstroke.
I swapped their captain's scabbard with a large leek.
You did not see me take that pouch.
I am literally watching you count the silver right now.
Misdirection is ninety percent of the art.
The other ten percent is having very fast running shoes.
beast: Did you hear that low, terrifying growl?
That was my empty stomach. It is nearly half past twelve.
The scent of raw meat stirs the blood!
The scent of mint sauce stirs my appetite. To each their own.
My claws itch for the thrill of the hunt.
Rub them against the fence. Duchess does it for hours.
We are creatures of instinct and fang!
I am a creature of sensible naps and the occasional biscuit.
A howl in the twilight unites the pack.
A sneeze in the bushes scatters them just as quickly.
undead: Your left thumb fell off into the porridge.
Death is not so bad once you get past the initial stiffness.
The draught through the ribcage is what bothers me.
We have eternity on our side.
Eternity is going to be dreadfully boring without a pack of cards.
Do you remember what sunlight felt like?
Warm, irritating, and terribly harsh on the complexion.
The living make such a fuss about breathing.
In, out, in, out. Exhausting just watching them.
machine: INSPECTION COMPLETE: STEAM VALVE AT MAXIMUM.
HISS LESS, CLANK MORE. WE ARE ATTEMPTING AN AMBUSH.
PRESSURE CHECK: OPTIMAL. CHASSIS INTEGRITY: SATISFACTORY.
YOU HAVE A PIGEON NESTING IN YOUR EXHAUST FUNNEL.
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: REDUCE HOSTILE DENSITY TO ZERO.
DO NOT SHOOT THE GOAT. THE GOAT HOLDS UP THE WHOLE OPERATION.
MIND THE CARPET. YOU LEAK COAL SLAG WHEN YOU SPRINT.
royal: Heavy is the head that wears the crown.
Take it off, then. A woollen cap is far more practical.
Our bloodline stretches back forty unbroken generations.
And each generation has had that exact same comical nose.
The realm demands sacrifice, dignity, and poise.
The realm would settle for lower tolls on turnip carts.
A monarch never bows, never stumbles, never yields.
You tripped over the palace rug this very morning, sire.
We rule by divine appointment and ancestral right.
And a slightly larger sword than our neighbours.
pirate: Where be the sea? We are six hundred leagues inland, matey.
A fair wind and a rich galleon, that is the life!
This is a cabbage field and a very slow bullock cart.
I buried a chest of doubloons under that peculiar oak.
Duchess ate the map, and the oak was chopped down in June.
Fifteen men on a dead man's chest!
And not one of them brought a corkscrew. Tragic.
Keep your eye on the booty and your hook out of your ear.
Sound advice, particularly regarding the hook.
gunner: Powder dry, barrel clean, match lit.
And your eyebrows singed off. Standard morning, then.
Lead is a remarkably convincing diplomatic argument.
Shame it makes such a dreadful racket before breakfast.
One shot, one hole, three very confused witnesses.
Provided you remember to load the lead ball before the wadding.
The smell of black powder in the morning air!
Smells like rotten eggs and ruined upholstery.
Give me twenty yards of clear lane and watch the fun.
Mind the recoil. Last time you ended up in a blackberry bush.
assassin: I was here twenty minutes before you arrived.
I have been here since yesterday. Under the floorboards.
A drop of nightshade in the evening posset. Clean.
A heavy brick from an upper window. Much cheaper.
We are shadows upon the sunlit wall.
You are wearing squeaky leather boots, friend.
No witnesses. That is the golden guild rule.
The goat saw everything. And she is judging your form.
The target is marked for collection.
Do not lose the receipt. The guild is very strict about the purse.
support: Is everyone feeling suitably warm and well fed?
We are being charged by forty orcs, friend.
A little soothing hum to keep morale buoyant.
Your humming is flat and driving the werewolf spare.
Remember to stretch your legs before engaging.
The enemy is not stretching. They are just running at us.
Bandages distributed! Lint plentiful! Smiles all round!
Someone stole my spleen while you were handing out mints.
I believe in you all! Every single flawed one of you!
Thank you, that was both uplifting and strangely insulting.
vanguard: First into the breach! Follow my plume!
After you, hero. Mind the spikes at the bottom.
A warrior does not look back!
Which explains why you missed the flank attack entirely.
Charge! For glory and immortal song!
And a moderately priced hot bath afterwards!
The front rank is where real history is written!
Mostly in deep bruises and shattered teeth.
I fear no beast, no man, no demon!
What about the small wasp crawling up your breastplate?
arcanist: My thesis on thaumaturgical density is practically finished.
Shame your practical demonstration just ignited the pantry.
The ethereal constants remain wonderfully immutable.
The goblin running at you with a cleaver seems quite constant too.
One must respect the delicate balance of the ley lines.
Tell that to the wizard who keeps tossing fireballs like apples.
In theory, this hex should invert their balance.
In practice, it made their trousers turn bright purple.
The mathematics of the cosmos are utterly flawless.
Your arithmetic on our inn bill was remarkably creative.
bulwark: Plant the boots. Lower the centre of gravity.
If you sink any deeper into the turf, we will need a spade.
I am the anvil upon which their weapons shatter.
And I am the poor soul behind the anvil getting hit by chips.
Nothing shifts me. Not wind, not tide, not ogres.
What about the announcement that dinner is served?
Solid iron from head to toe.
Must be dreadful when the sun comes out at midday.
They cannot take the hill while I draw breath.
Then breathe very slowly and keep your visor down.

loading_tips: Tip: high ground hits harder, and shooters reach further from it. Duchess has said so for years. Nobody listens to the goat.
Tip: blows from behind hit hardest. Politeness is for the front.
Tip: three of the same hero merge into a stronger one. Do not try this with goats.
Tip: skills fire on their own when the gold bar fills. Heroes love a full bar. Duchess prefers a full trough.
Tip: drag a hero you do not need onto Recycle to get gold back. They are told it is a promotion.
Tip: the king's spells run on mana, which fills slowly as the fight goes on. Spend it where it hurts.
Tip: the Mage Tower makes the king's mana fill faster. The wizards say it was their idea.
Tip: the Treasury adds starting gold to every run. The coins do not multiply, but they do get counted twice.
Tip: the Barracks add health and the Armoury adds attack for every hero. The builders argue about the roofs.
Tip: castle builds take real time, one at a time, and carry on while the game is closed. Duchess supervises.
Tip: if the party falls, a heart burns and the wave starts again with bonus gold. No hearts left, no second chance.
Tip: the Last Stand never ends. Foes come from every side, and a boss arrives every fifth wave.
Tip: between Last Stand waves you can spend gold to level heroes, heal the king or buy relics. The king pays up, grumbling.
Tip: in the Last Stand, a wave that drags on makes its foes angrier. Finish them before they lose their patience.
Tip: tall grass hides a fighter from shots, and some blows on them simply miss. Ideal for hiding, or for goats.
Tip: a blow beside a powder barrel sets it off, and everyone within a tile is hurt. Mind where the wizard stands.
Tip: healing shrines mend whoever stands on them, friend or foe. Do not leave the shrine to the other side.
Tip: ice is quick but slippery, and walkers sometimes slide an extra tile. Skates are not provided.
Tip: deep water can only be crossed by fliers. Everyone else needs a bridge or a ford.
Tip: lava burns whoever steps in it, and again each second they stay. Fliers pass over it unharmed.
Tip: ruined walls block shots, even from higher ground. Stand behind one and the archers just glare.
Tip: two different heroes who share a trait wake its team bonus. Two of the same hero count only once.
Tip: five heroes of one set, fighting together, fill the Last Oath bar and unleash a mighty shared move.
Tip: every hero learns an ultimate at level 30. It is worth the wait, and the grumbling.
Tip: the Library adds extra XP from every fight. The books stay unread, but the XP is real.
Tip: Crowns buy chests, and chests hold summoning stones. Duchess has checked the stones. They are not edible.
Tip: stars from clearing armies open the Castle, the Last Stand and the Calamity. Duchess has eaten two of hers.
Tip: the Chapel holds the king's spells. Pick three that fit the power budget, and cast them where it hurts.
Tip: in the Calamity you climb the maps with one hero, hiring more at camps and shops. Each map ends in a boss.
Tip: tap Duchess and she will answer. She has opinions, and none of them are in words.
foe_grumbles: Management insists we are fully staffed. There are four of us and an elderly badger.
The pay is miserable, the holidays are imaginary, and the uniform gives me a rash.
I was assured at recruitment that this post was mostly ceremonial skulking.
Another wave of heroes? We have not finished counting the bruises from the last lot.
I have not had a feast day off since the third siege of the outer turnip fields.
There were twelve in our raiding party yesterday. Seven quit for a travelling circus.
My orders said light menacing, not catching fiery meteors with my chin.
Can we postpone the war until after four? There are scones arriving on the baggage cart.
I demand to speak to whoever authorised this campaign. Oh, it is the warlord. Never mind.
An elite legion, they said. We share three working spears between twenty men.
Health and safety came round. They condemned our spiked pit as a tripping hazard.
They told me the keep had gold. It has a sarcastic goat and several very angry hedgehogs.
The king dropped a rock from the sky on my tent. It was handed down from my uncle.
I asked for a promotion to heavy brute. They gave me a taller wooden plank and less soup.
Why do the heroes get shiny silver breastplates while we get rusted barrel hoops?
Our battle standard blew away on Tuesday. We now rally round an old tablecloth.
We were told the heroes were weak. Whoever said so was sitting far from the front.
If one more person shouts 'charge' before I have finished my tea, I am filing a grievance.
Nobody warned me about being kicked in the face by a celestial paladin.
They cut our rations because the last three sieges failed. That does not help.
The dark lord has forty rooms in his citadel and we are sleeping three to an open ditch.
Another inspection? My performance depends entirely on the quality of my spearhead.
I asked for border patrol. Instead I get frontline catapult duty.
The heroes have a dedicated healer. We have an orc who rubs dry mud on compound fractures.
They never supply enough arrows. We have been shooting sharpened broom handles all week.
I signed up to plunder villages, not to be turned to ice by an eccentric wizard.
Our general has never swung an axe. He has seven ornamental sashes, though.
The dragon is laid up with indigestion. So now the infantry must provide the fire.
Who designed these iron boots? They fill with rainwater and weigh half a hundredweight.
The recruiting sergeant promised boundless plunder. So far: half an onion and a splinter.
I am thinking of early retirement. Assuming the paladin does not hurry it along.
We held a council about morale. Morale fell by twelve percent during the meeting.
The necromancer raised me on a Sunday. Not a word about Sunday rates.
Can nobody on our side aim straight? We have hit more trees than heroes this campaign.
My armour squeaks with every step. The heroes hear me three minutes before I arrive.
They said the castle defenders were peasants. Nobody mentioned the pitchforks.
I am down to my last breeches, and the rear seam is giving up.
The king has cast four meteors in ten minutes. Has the man no regard for the landscape?
Every time I think things cannot get worse, the horn blows for another assault.
If I survive this skirmish, I am defecting to the tavern. They have warm porridge.
recap_win: The enemy has lodged a formal complaint with their guild. It has been filed in the grate.
Duchess watched the whole fight from a comfortable mound. She looked mildly amused.
A handsome victory. The tavern bard has drafted three wildly inaccurate ballads.
The realm rejoices. The enemy baggage train has been impounded for tea and biscuits.
The heralds were routed in exemplary fashion. Not a single royal tea saucer was cracked.
A masterclass in battlefield tactics. Even the castle stonemason offered a grudging nod.
The surviving foes were seen sprinting for the horizon in some disarray.
A clean sweep. The quartermaster is already pricing their rusted helmets.
Duchess nibbled a corner of the victory ribbon. High praise indeed from the court goat.
The heroes stood proud upon the ridge, pretending their knees were not shaking violently.
The kingdom is safe for another afternoon. The heroes have demanded a four-course supper.
The warlord left his ceremonial hat behind in his haste. It makes a fine soup bowl.
recap_loss: Duchess has witnessed more competent tactical displays from a herd of drunken sheep.
A slight miscalculation. The heroes have agreed to blame the crosswind.
The party was routed, though everyone kept an exceptionally high standard of posture.
A learning experience. Chiefly, that charging five ogres at once is ill-advised.
The heroes insist the enemy broke several unwritten rules. A report will be drawn up.
Duchess sniffed the battlefield, sighed deeply, and returned to her thistles in disgust.
Defeat tastes remarkably like damp grass and bruised pride. Onward to the next attempt.
The king dropped a meteor, but it landed on a patch of exceptionally dry clover.
A temporary setback. The heroes are soaking their bruises in vinegar.
The enemy celebrated by eating our packed lunches. That was the cruellest insult of all.
The line buckled. We shall tell the town crier it was a planned retreat.
The party fell in a heap. The heap declines to take responsibility for the formation.
result_win: The foes have retired to reconsider their careers. Excellent work all round.
Victory is ours. Please scrape the mud off your boots before entering the Great Hall.
Rousing cheers from the parapets! Duchess celebrated by eating a spare banner tassel.
Still on our feet, mostly. That is the accepted technical definition of military success.
The battlefield is cleared. Collect the loose arrows and see to the wounded.
A splendid demonstration of martial vigour. The king awards everyone an extra biscuit.
The enemy line dissolved like cheap sugar in a hot cup of tea. Top marks, heroes.
Not a scratch on the royal carriage. The party, however, could use a thorough polishing.
The foe was routed, their standards captured, and their complaints utterly disregarded.
Triumph achieved with minimal fuss. Now, who remembered to light the tavern fire?
The kingdom endures, largely thanks to good placement and remarkably sturdy shields.
A grand outcome. The enemy will think twice before trampling the king's flowerbeds again.
result_loss: Everyone is in a bruised heap. The heap blames the king; the king blames the gradient.
A minor catastrophe. Let us pretend it was an elaborate dress rehearsal.
Heroes fall, empires crumble, but goats, notably, continue chewing indifferent thistle.
You may now claim you were merely luring them into a false sense of overwhelming triumph.
The field belongs to the enemy for the moment. They are welcome to the mud and midges.
Down for the count. A hot bath and six yards of fresh linen should mend the damage.
Tactical disaster, though the heroism displayed was of an exceptionally photogenic order.
The line collapsed. Fortunately, the tavern cellar remains entirely unbreached.
A bruising defeat. We shall review the placement charts and omit the embarrassing parts.
Flat on your backs, looking at the clouds. A tranquil end to a rather noisy afternoon.
The party needs a great deal of stitching. The cleric has prepared a very stern face.
Defeated, but undefeated in spirit. By spirit, we mean stubborn refusal to admit fault.
