hero_story.knight: Sir Aldric guarded the gate for forty winters without once inquiring why. They say a blow that falls upon his oak shield vibrates through the castle foundations, rattling every kettle.
hero_story.samurai: He crossed the eastern ocean carrying one blade and an unspoken oath. No soul has dared ask what he promised, largely because he looks like a man who dislikes small talk.
hero_story.kunoichi: Moonlit slates and a brisk breeze are all she requires. She was already crouching behind your left shoulder before you even had the bright idea to look behind you.
hero_story.archer: He hunted the freezing crags where one high arrow outmatches three from the mud. He has never missed a stag, and no enemy has ever survived to critique his aim.
hero_story.wizard: His first spark incinerated a barn, and his second flattened a dovecote. He now aims his conflagrations exclusively at things that thoroughly deserve a good roasting.
hero_story.peasant: Armed with a rusty fork and twelve neighbours who all chose the same dawn to be brave. In a packed crowd, an outraged farmer hits harder than three paid mercenaries.
hero_story.ninjaMonk: He swore a sacred vow never to bear cold steel, then swore an equal vow to win every bout. His calloused knuckles are the diplomatic compromise between piety and violence.
hero_story.wanderer: She strolled off the king's highway one twilight and declined to explain her origin. Wherever her muddy boots tread, the wounded dust themselves off and stand tall.
hero_story.lightningMage: Thunderstorms dog his footsteps from shire to shire, and neither is certain who leads. His electric arcs leap playfully between foes, accompanied by a rather alarming chuckle.
hero_story.kitsune: A fox spirit who learned to tolerate humans, and then learned how to bamboozle them. Any foe ensnared by her melody will gleefully thump his comrades until the jig ends.
hero_story.karasu: A crow spirit of the windy crags, slow to anger and delightfully quick to dive. Bowmen lurking at the rear of the enemy line are his preferred afternoon sport.
hero_story.yamabushi: He meditated in a gale so ferocious it carved jagged peaks into his bones. Now when he snaps his fan, the mountain winds obey and shove foes off the ledges.
hero_story.werewolf: The first full moon was polite; the second tore his breeches to ribbons. He retained the lupine savagery and completely discarded the habit of apologising.
hero_story.minotaur: He discovered the labyrinth's exit by simply walking through the exterior masonry. He has favoured the direct, headlong approach to problem-solving ever since.
hero_story.satyr: He pipes at rustic weddings, and at border wars when the coin purse is heavier. His lively tempo tricks exhausted calves into sprinting straight into the fray.
hero_story.gorgon: She keeps her veil pinned in town, and removes it only for pressing social engagements. Foes who hold her gaze discover they suddenly have urgent business being marble.
hero_story.samuraiCommander: He once defended a stone bridge with a hundred brave men against a thousand. The ragged standard he carries is the selfsame silk, mended with care in nine places.
hero_story.paladin: He took his holy vows amidst the gore of a battlefield and has been scouring it ever since. Foes are drawn to his blinding sheen, while his shield knits his flesh.
hero_story.cleric: She asks no foolish questions of the bleeding, only whether they take sugar in their tea. Her quiet prayers mend shattered bones slowly, ensuring they knit to stay.
hero_story.druid: The ancient oaks do her bidding whenever she remembers to ask politely. A towering treant at her flank serves as a living bulwark that sprouts fresh leaves as it thumps.
hero_story.barbarian: He enters the fray as though each fresh wound were an affectionate promise. The more vitality the enemy carves from his hide, the harder his great axe swings.
hero_story.ranger: She lays her iron snares in the midnight weeds and notches her arrows by dawn. By the hour the enemy notices either, it is far too late to dodge both.
hero_story.warlock: He inked an eldritch contract without bothering to consult a qualified notary. His curses scorch the foe and, per the binding terms of clause four, feed his vigour.
hero_story.illusionist: There is a woman before you, another behind your guard, and a third slipping away. Only one is flesh and blood, and she has no intention of spoiling the mystery.
hero_story.gunslinger: A deliberate pull, immense reach, and never a grain of black powder wasted. She reloads her smoking iron in the brief time it takes a pious soldier to say grace.
hero_story.shambler: He cannot recall the details of his passing, and sees no profit in brooding over it. His rotting touch spreads pestilence, and his severed bits stitch back together.
hero_story.rifleBot: Forged for an ancient war that concluded before its boiler was lit. It rattles off brass bursts, tallies every shell, and has never submitted an official complaint.
hero_story.mercenary: He fights solely for cold crowns, though he holds strong professional principles. The most formidable monster on the field carries the fattest bounty, so he strikes it first.
hero_story.mummy: Enveloped in three centuries of dusty linen and an unresolved personal grudge. His trailing wrappings entangle the enemy, leaving them thoroughly bound and embarrassed.
hero_story.buccaneer: She hooks enemy shooters with a roguish wink and cuts them down before the grin fades. Across fifty boarding actions, she has never once surrendered her tricorn.
hero_story.wolfBard: A mournful dirge for the dying and a jaunty tune for his companions. The pack howls enthusiastically along, and nobody possesses the cruelty to tell him he is flat.
hero_story.beastmaster: The grey wolves rallied to her copper whistle and refused to depart. A cracking bullwhip hobbles the vanguard, leaving her beasts to finish the debate.
hero_story.kraken: He drifted with the leviathan until the beast grew bored and coughed him ashore. The roaring undertow clings to his heels, dragging foes into boarding distance.
hero_story.lancer: A couched lance, iron stirrups, and a heavy destrier that listens far better than the king. Once he smashes through their battle line, the momentum only accelerates.
hero_story.reaper: Death is a bureaucratic trade like any other, and she prefers the quiet night shift. Any wretch teetering on the edge of the grave falls under her jurisdiction.
hero_story.timeWitch: She cradles an invisible hourglass carved from starlight. While the enemy's seconds drag like cold molasses, her companions dart forward like midsummer swallows.
hero_story.arcBlade: A mechanical swordsman engineered to blink into enemy clusters and discharge a thunderbolt. A fresh scent of ozone and scorched earth lingers in his wake.
hero_story.dreadPirate: Drowned in iron twice, and thoroughly bored by the experience. The ghostly broadside he unleashes is merely an overture; strike him down, and he rises again.
hero_story.siegeBot: Constructed to reduce granite battlements to powder. It makes do with clustered foes, lobbing heavy iron shells with the cold, measured rhythm of a clocktower.
hero_story.priestess: The floating halo is far from decorative. She knits the deepest wounds of her allies, while radiating an aegis that shields all who cluster beneath her mantle.
hero_story.dragoon: The wyvern queen wears an iron diadem and has never slipped from the saddle. She wheels through the clouds, bathing enemy files in continuous torrents of fire.
hero_story.juggernaut: A fortress wall that grew tired of standing still and learned to march. When its granite foot stamps down, every living thing in the parish reconsiders its purpose.
hero_story.sage: He studied the heavens so intensely that the constellations began studying him back. He calls down stellar fire on three crowds, replenishing his allies' skill meters as he watches.
hero_story.demonSwordsman: He feeds upon the lifeblood he cleaves, while the demon slumbering in the steel drains him. The longer the battle drags, the fuzzier the distinction between them.
hero_story.tyrant: He reigns through ruthless decree, crushing the mutinous and rallying the loyal with a glare. In forty years on the magistrate's bench, he has never lost a verdict.

foe_lore.skeleton: Bound to a long-dead king, he still hoists his rusted rim for an impact that never arrived.
foe_lore.spearman: The extended reach of an ancient pledge. He jabs from two tiles off, convinced he is still on shift.
foe_lore.boneArcher: Whatever quarry he chased in life is dust, so he shoots heroes instead. Being dead hasn't hurt his eye.
foe_lore.boneVolley: A marksman of the ancient barrows. The dry clatter of his willow bow is a scout's final memory.
foe_lore.wolfBlack: Senior hunter of the timber pack. He strikes alone when his cousins hesitate, which is almost never.
foe_lore.wolfRed: Stained crimson from muzzle to flank, and rarely with his own blood. Quick to snap, quicker to bolt.
foe_lore.wolfWhite: Pale as mountain rime and lighter on his paws than his kin. By the hour you spot him, you are dinner.
foe_lore.minotaur1: The winding corridors conceal him well. When he lowers his horns, only exterior walls halt the rush.
foe_lore.gorgon1: Her stony scowl is charming to hear about by a tavern fire. Her bone-barbed bolts are far less poetic.
foe_lore.satyr1: A merry rogue until the music ceases. He skirmishes as he reels: nimble, swift, and never stationary.
foe_lore.groveSatyr1: The grove-dwellers pipe to the timber wolves, quickening their stride. Silence the flute, or run.
foe_lore.orcGrunt: Inexpensive, deafening, and everywhere. A horde relies on grunts, winning by sheer disposable bulk.
foe_lore.orcArcher: Bent bow and a crooked sneer. He loiters behind the line, letting expendable grunts soak the steel.
foe_lore.orcBrute: Far too bulky for the iron welded onto his hide. Each heavy blow gathers momentum and lands hard.
foe_lore.imp: A splinter of malice with a rusted fork. Imps avoid solitary skirmishes; no single imp has the spine.
foe_lore.demon: Wings of cracked hide and a temper to match. He drops upon the frailest defender without asking names.
foe_lore.ogre: Possesses a knotty club and an atrocious temper. The two are closely linked, and neither will improve.
foe_lore.orcWarlord: Stood upon a heap of dented bucklers to claim the mantle. He awaits someone fool enough to challenge it.
foe_lore.demonLord: He rarely bothers to draw steel. Raising a single talon brings imps pouring from the jagged dark.
foe_lore.hornedOgre: An ogre who survived long enough to sprout horns and the foul spite to use them. The ground heaves.
foe_lore.forestBoss1: Tangled briars, gnarled roots, and a long memory. The thicket grew round him; he will not yield.
foe_lore.forestBoss2: A marauder of the high canopy, darting like an owl through boughs. Nothing under the leaves escapes him.
foe_lore.forestBoss3: His ash spear outdates the sacred grove it defends. Its tip finds your throat before you close the gap.
foe_lore.orcChieftain: Carries the clan's totems and ancient grudges. Wherever his banner planted, the rabble forget fear.
foe_lore.boneCaptain: Leader of a cohort that never returned from the crusade. His guidon is lint; his dead follow still.
foe_lore.alphaWolf: The pack obeys his guttural snarl. He singles out the limping defender first, and his jaws never fail.
foe_lore.gorgonQueen: Her unblinking glare is the last sight many a hero beholds: a creeping frost, and eternal stone.
foe_lore.lichKing: Dead for an age and occupied every day of it. He chills the living and recruits the fallen for company.
foe_lore.minotaurChampion: The labyrinth's finest butcher. He gores, charges, and ignores wounds that would fell three horses.
foe_lore.yokaiFox: A spectral fox who never occupies the spot you strike. Cleave twice, and you have struck two phantoms.
foe_lore.yokaiWitch: She hexes the sturdiest defender; the mighty offer the sweetest tribute. Her smile is part of the hex.
foe_lore.yokaiCrow: He drops from storm clouds onto the backline shooter, evaporating before a return arrow is nocked.
foe_lore.yokaiSeer: A raven seer who knows too much. One glance at your greatest knight, and he strikes for the spirits.
foe_lore.yokaiMonk: The alpine blizzard answers his chant. Heroes lingering near slippery drops rarely linger long.
foe_lore.nineTails: Nine velvet brushes, nine centuries of malice. Her shimmering foxfire turns trusted comrades on each other.
foe_lore.oniKing: The midnight parade bows to his iron club. One thunderous roar drives the vanguard back in disarray.
foe_lore.stoneGolem: Chiselled from the ridge and commanded to guard it. He has stood his watch, and the cliff is secure.
foe_lore.ironGolem: Plated in thick pig iron and slow to the verge of insult. Heroes strike his plating, and blades snap.
foe_lore.crystalGolem: A pulsing core of raw geode. Jagged splinters fly from his flanks to pin heroes to the turf.
foe_lore.magmaGolem: Still glowing from the subterranean furnace. His fist leaves molten slag, and the mud remembers.
foe_lore.sapphireColossus: Deep blue as a mountain tarn and hard as diamond. When his crystal shrapnel flies, take cover.
foe_lore.forgeTitan: The primal forge's opening hammer and its last. Each strike rings like an anvil; his chest furnace roars.
foe_lore.boarKing: He brakes for no wall and swerves for no hero. The line is merely an obstacle between him and forage.
foe_lore.devilLeader: Commands the pit from the vanguard, showering hellfire upon anything that isn't actively incinerating.
foe_lore.shamanKing: Sizzling arcs from afar and wards for his braves. He understands a war is decided behind the ranks.
foe_lore.eliteGorrak: The horde's master bone-breaker. The more iron you drive into his ribs, the wider his ugly grin.
foe_lore.eliteYsolde: The pack follows her eerie yip. Each slaughter quickens her paws, and she has had centuries of drill.
foe_lore.eliteHollow: A sacred oath that outlasted its master. He wanders in rusted iron, holding the gate with an empty shrug.
foe_lore.eliteSethra: Avert your eyes or join the masonry. Crossbow quarrels glance from her scales; her stare never wavers.
foe_lore.eliteBrakka: The maze spat him out, and he remains deeply aggrieved. The frailer you appear, the harder he clubs.
foe_lore.eliteCindra: Where her hooves fall, the heather ignites. Her sweeping strikes leave lingering embers to finish you.
foe_lore.eliteVexor: Never engages alone. When his skirmishers fall, a sharp whistle summons another ragged dozen.
foe_lore.eliteThrum: Older than the stone turnpike, and in no hurry. He shoves the front rank back without flinching once.
foe_lore.eliteNyssa: Her pale touch withers the stoutest knight. The vigour she drains tastes sweetest from the mighty.
foe_lore.eliteWarden: Nothing passes without toll, and he dislikes your face. Plated and grounded; don't bother shoving.
foe_lore.eliteKuro: Plummets onto archers from the overcast, vanishing back into the grey before boots hit the heather.
foe_lore.eliteSilenus: Every jig concludes with a funeral. His frantic pipes drive the pack into a relentless frenzy.
foe_lore.calBoss1: First herald of the Calamity, grey with cinder. The deeper his wounds, the more savagely he hews.
foe_lore.calBoss2: The ancient briar that remembers every woodman's axe. A thicket of spikes shields him; he never heals.
foe_lore.calBoss3: Master of the infinite horde. His impish retinue never thins, and his wounds knit as fast as you cut.
foe_lore.calBoss4: The living mountain. He shoves whole formations back, while no battering ram has ever budged him.
foe_lore.calBoss5: Keeper of the dying cinder. What he poisons he consumes, growing bloated upon your party's collapse.
foe_lore.calBoss6: The terminus of all journeys. Armed with every herald's malice, and a final charge to seal the keep.

opening.title: The Road Begins
opening.blurb: Your three brave pioneers meet the king, the court goat and the first army on the road.

lines.text: Every army in the land is marching on the Last Keep. Some brought packed lunches.
Right. Who gets the honour of the sharp end?
You do. You are literally standing on it.
The king of the Last Keep places the heroes. That is you.
After that, they scrap. Applaud, or drop a meteor.
Applause is lovely, majesty. We prefer the meteor.
Mehh.
Duchess, the court goat: Her Grace, not the king. She disagrees.
I should like to stand three miles further back.
The first army was on the road.

gorvak.title: The Ashen Road
gorvak.blurb: Gorvak the Ashen, the Calamity's first herald, keeps a very firm roadblock in the void.

lines.text: Past the portal lies the void, with a road of soot and something on it.
HALT! NONE PASS THE ASHEN ROAD!
Is there a way round?
THERE IS. I AM STANDING ON THAT TOO.
You did say watch the side lanes, boss.
AND?!
We were a grunt short. Compassionate leave.
Mehh.
THAT IS AN UNLICENSED GOAT!
She is covering the side lanes, boss.
THEN I SHALL BURN YOU ALL MYSELF!
Behold the first herald. He has had no tea break since the war.

calamityOpens.title: A Hole in the Sky
calamityOpens.blurb: A portal rips open over the keep, an invasion pours out, and somebody has to go in.

lines.text: One quiet night, the sky over the keep ripped open like a cheap tent.
Through the tear: a portal. Beyond it, the void. Out of it, an invasion.
Can we shut it from this side?
The latch is on the far side. Naturally.
The king sends one hero through, and more may join beyond. That is you, choosing.
Into the void, then. I shall want a very long bath afterwards.
Beyond the portal, six heralds lead the invasion. Together they are the Calamity.
It was not consulted on the name.

thornWarden.title: The Bramble's Grudge
thornWarden.blurb: The Thorn Warden maintains a frosty silence, leaving everyone feeling thoroughly judged.

lines.text: Deeper into the void, the way is all hedge, the grudge-holding sort.
The Thorn Warden says nothing, reproachfully.
Does the shrubbery ever talk?
Once. In the Great Frost. Mostly aphids.
He says he knows your axe handle.
I have no axe. This is a staff.
He knows your guilty aura anyway.
I feel I am failing a botany inspection.
Mehh.
The Warden raised one bough, and the briar sighed.
Behold the second herald. His ribbon is delayed in the post.

malphas.title: Item One: The Breach
malphas.blurb: Malphas summons the infernal legions, but the legions sent a bureaucrat.

lines.text: Further in, the void keeps a court, torches, and a long agenda.
I AM MALPHAS! I CALL THE HORDES!
Item one, my lord: the gatehouse.
WHAT ABOUT THE GATEHOUSE?!
Item two: the back door is brambles.
WHERE ARE MY NINE DIVISIONS?!
In committee, sire. Arguing about pay.
HOW MANY DEMONS DO I COMMAND?!
Just me, sire. The scroll is on loan.
Mehh.
STRIKE THAT FROM THE MINUTES!
Behold the third herald. His ribbon is in purgatory.

hrungar.title: The Walking Masonry
hrungar.blurb: Hrungar the Mountain is tested with a modest shove, purely in the interest of science.

lines.text: A pass through the void is blocked by a remarkably solid obstruction in iron plate.
I shall give you an experimental nudge, to test your balance.
WAS THAT INTENDED TO BE A HOSTILE NUDGE?!
IN FOUR CENTURIES, NEITHER WIND NOR SEVERE SIEGE HAS BUDGED ME!
You slid twenty yards during the spring avalanche, boss.
THAT WAS A DIGNIFIED STRATEGIC RELOCATION!
Hrungar cannot be shoved. The heroes have verified this with several bruised wrists.
Mehh.
Behold the fourth herald. His commemorative ribbon is awaiting dispatch.

vorgrath.title: The Fragile Spark
vorgrath.blurb: Vorgrath the Hellbringer guards the cosmic ember, which is struggling in the breeze.

lines.text: The void's fifth reach is sulphur and cinder, with one small flame fiercely guarded.
BEHOLD THE LAST FLAME OF THE WORLD!
That is an ordinary candle from the larder.
IT CARRIES TREMENDOUS GRAVITAS!
SOMEONE SHUT THAT DOOR IMMEDIATELY!
We are on an open plateau, my dark master.
THEN ERECT A WINDBREAK AT ONCE!
Mehh.
The goat is snorting on the wick, sire.
NOW MY MOMENT IS RUINED AND THE WICK IS DEAD!
Behold the fifth herald. His ribbon is in transit.

karnok.title: The Terminus
karnok.blurb: Karnok, at the heart of the void, brings the end of all roads, including the quick route to the baker.

lines.text: At the heart of the void, the invasion's own gate. The clouds look bruised.
I AM KARNOK! I AM THE END OF ALL ROADS!
Does that include every road?
EVERY SINGLE ONE!
Even the lane to the confectioner's?
...LET ME CONSULT THE MAPS.
The other heralds are in the servants' hall.
ON WHAT GROUNDS?!
They wait for their ribbons.
Mehh.
THEN I SHALL FLATTEN YOUR CITADEL MYSELF!
Behold the final herald. His ribbon was lost in transit.

calamityEnds.title: Unscripted Horizons
calamityEnds.blurb: Karnok topples, the portal seals itself, and nobody planned for peace.

lines.text: THE END OF ALL ROADS... IS SOMEWHAT PREMATURE.
The final herald fell like a wardrobe: slowly, then crashingly.
Back home, the portal sighed and sealed shut. A finch piped up.
Is that the end of the invasion?
What do we do now? My afternoon is clear.
I had not planned past five o'clock.
Any jobs at the keep? I came through before it shut.
Mehh.
The king was thanked for placing everyone, then only watching.
To celebrate, a meteor fell on an empty cabbage plot.

firstLoss.title: A Matter of Geometry
firstLoss.blurb: The party's maiden defeat prompts an exceptionally polite inquest regarding fault.

lines.text: Every legendary host has a first clumsy afternoon.
This was the heroes' first. They bore it with dignity and bandages.
I trust nobody is vulgar enough to blame my placement.
It was arguably thirty percent the placement, darling.
I requested thirty paces to the rear. I was told that was the hedge.
The king, who placed everyone and only watched, was quietly blamed.
Perhaps try the eastern flank tomorrow, majesty. Just a thought.
Mehh.
Tomorrow, they resolved, would be more dignified. Duchess was sceptical.

eliteMet.title: Unsolicited Stand-Up
eliteMet.blurb: An elite champion introduces himself like an energetic comedian to an indifferent crowd.

lines.text: Certain champions are sturdier than the rest, and insist on delivering an opening monologue.
Good evening, lords and ladies! Is this scrying crystal working?!
I believe you are meant to be bloodthirsty.
I am bloodthirsty! Excessively bloodthirsty! Try the roast mutton!
Difficult room tonight. Very stiff. Ah, a four-legged ruminant in the stalls! Splendid!
Mehh.
Good grief, even the local livestock is heckling my opening material.
Right then. Enough pleasant banter. Let me demonstrate my signature routine!

ascensionOne.title: A Fresh Chapeau
ascensionOne.blurb: The Calamity, bitterly wounded in its vanity, returns sporting upgraded headwear.

lines.text: The portal has torn open again. The Calamity handles defeat very poorly.
BEHOLD! I HAVE RETURNED TO EXACT VENGEANCE!
You appear somewhat changed in your general aspect.
MY HEALTH IS GREATLY ENLARGED!
And the feathered headgear?
Found it in the sale at the haberdasher's, boss.
I FIND THE OSTRICH PLUME EXTREMELY INTIMIDATING!
We all admire the plume, boss. Please don't ask us to swear an oath to it.
FURTHERMORE, MY STATURE HAS BEEN AUGMENTED BY THREE INCHES!

dailyBoss.title: The Daily Bulletin
dailyBoss.blurb: The morning's champion is presented like a regional weather forecast with a mace.

lines.text: Good morning. Today's calamity is brought to you by an exceptionally portly boar.
Scattered squalls of violence are expected later, with heavy tusks in the west.
IS THIS THE CORRECT DAY?!
It is today, yes. Approximately half past nine.
MY DISPATCH OFFICER SPECIFICALLY CONFIRMED A THURSDAY ENGAGEMENT!
He attends every morning with commendable punctuality and his own commemorative tankard.
Mehh.
PARDON ME, BUT I HAVE AN APPOINTMENT. COMMENCE THE CHARGE!

mythicOpens.title: A Very Grand Helmet
mythicOpens.blurb: An army unlocks on Mythic difficulty, and its chieftain brings out the Sunday armour.

lines.text: There exist strata of violence far above Legendary. They are felt chiefly in the teeth.
I HAVE CONSULTED NUMEROUS TACTICAL TREATISES!
The effort is plainly discernible.
I HAVE PRACTISED MY FEROCIOUS ROAR IN FRONT OF A LOOKING GLASS!
He rehearsed in the cellar so the chickens wouldn't lose their nerve.
AND OBSERVE MY SECONDARY CEREMONIAL PLUME!
He means his spare visor. We find it best not to contradict him.
TREMBLE BEFORE THE FINEST WARBAND EVER ASSEMBLED!

duchessInFight.title: An Unregistered Entry
duchessInFight.blurb: Duchess wanders directly between the battle lines, and etiquette prevents interruption.

lines.text: Right in the middle of a delicate tactical flanking manoeuvre, a white shape intervened.
I say, is that an unescorted goat wandering the battlefield?
That is Her Grace the Duchess. Mind your tone.
Does she fight for your side, or does she seek union with our cause?
Mehh.
She fights exclusively for herself. Today her interests aligned with the winners.

clear:orcs.title: Orc Warband: Routed
clear:orcs.blurb: The Orc Warlord takes a knee to catch his breath and lodge an administrative complaint.

lines.text: The Orc Warlord dropped onto one knee, the traditional tribal gesture meaning 'mild setback'.
THIS ENGAGEMENT IS VOID! TAKE DOWN THAT STATEMENT IN THE CHRONICLES!
Who has the quill, boss? Someone took it to draw on the wall.
He will require a remarkably large scroll to list all the grievances.
Shall we inform his dear mother, or will the surviving grunts draft the letter?
Mehh.
The remaining orcs held a brief symposium on maternal correspondence. The heroes waited politely.

clear:undead.title: Undead Legion: Taking a Number
clear:undead.blurb: The Lich King falls apart with poise, and joins the queue for reincarnation.

lines.text: The Lich King collapsed into a tidy pile of bleached calcium with immense theatrical dignity.
DEATH IS MERELY A PAUSE! ...HOLD ON, I AM FOURTH IN THE QUEUE FOR REINCARNATION.
Please take a number, your majesty.
I always assumed the underworld ran more smoothly.
Is it bad form to leave a skeleton waiting in the queue?
Mehh.
The bony cohort filed quietly back into their crypts. Several noted their upcoming appointments.

clear:beasts.title: Beast Packs: Dispersed
clear:beasts.blurb: The Boar King examines the clover very closely, insisting he was never actually felled.

lines.text: The Boar King does not fall. He merely undertook an urgent, horizontal inspection of the moss.
A MONARCH OF THE TUSK NEVER FALLS! HE MERELY... INSPECTS THE SOIL!
The pack has several pressing concerns about the inspection, sire.
Sit. Lie down. Good boar. Stay right there until morning.
He is an exceptionally bulky pig to look so deeply heartbroken over a skirmish.
Mehh.
The pack drifted off across the heather, casting rather embarrassed glances over their shoulders.

clear:wildwood.title: The Wildwood: Trimmed
clear:wildwood.blurb: The Spearlord leans heavily upon his shaft, which was not designed for structural support.

lines.text: The Grove Spearlord leaned heavily upon his ash lance, bending it in an undignified arch.
THE SACRED TIMBER WILL HEAR OF THIS INDIGNITY!
The sacred timber is away at a canopy meeting. May I take a message?
Inform the grove we pinned a polite eviction notice to the nearest birch.
It truly was an exceptionally picturesque thicket before we trampled it.
Mehh.
Deep within the grove, an ancient elder tree took offence. The leaves rustled in bitter agreement.

clear:labyrinth.title: The Labyrinth: Solved
clear:labyrinth.blurb: The Minotaur Champion takes a seat in the centre of his puzzle, thoroughly outmanoeuvred.

lines.text: The Minotaur Champion sat heavily upon the flagstones of his puzzle, puffing through his nose.
THE LABYRINTH... YOU SIMPLY WALKED STRAIGHT DOWN THE CORRIDOR!
We did put up several helpful arrows, boss. For the travellers.
The wooden arrows did say 'This Way to the Minotaur', to be fair.
We felt it would have been terribly rude to wander into the dead ends on purpose.
Mehh.
The maze was gifted a brand-new sign: 'Under New Management, Currently Strolling in Circles'.

clear:ogres.title: Ogre Clans: Luncheon
clear:ogres.blurb: The Horned Ogre sways like a collapsing haystack and calls a recess for broth.

lines.text: The Horned Ogre wobbled twice, pondered the merits of standing, and chose to sit with a thud.
THE CRAG DOES NOT CRUMBLE... WAIT, WHO BROUGHT THE COLD PIES?
It is mutton broth today, chief. We had a rather heated shouting match about it.
I propose we declare an armistice in the interest of personal nourishment.
The smell of mutton broth was remarkably distracting throughout the second phase.
Mehh.
The ogres adjourned for luncheon. The deliberations extended well into the following Thursday.

clear:infernal.title: Infernal Host: Appealed
clear:infernal.blurb: The Demon Lord is vanquished, but relies on a technical loophole in the small print.

lines.text: The Demon Lord was soundly thrashed, but the sort of thrashed that arrives with a receipt.
THIS SETBACK IS TEMPORARY! MY CONTRACT COVERS THREE SEPARATE RESURRECTIONS!
Paragraph nine says the guarantee excludes damage by righteous paladins, sire.
Always consult a certified notary before signing contracts in brimstone.
He always seemed far too fond of reading the microscopic annotations.
Mehh.
The imps lodged a formal appeal. It was stamped, countersigned, and cast into the molten basalt.

clear:yokai.title: Night Parade: Concluded
clear:yokai.blurb: The Oni King strikes his sacred thunder drum once, discovering an absence of mallets.

lines.text: The Oni King hoisted his great thunder drum, struck it with flourish, and produced only a squeak.
THE CELESTIAL DRUM... HAS BEEN DEPRIVED OF ITS SACRED MALLETS!
We loaned them to the tengu scouts to crack walnuts, your majesty.
A musical instrument is only as fearsome as its percussive accessories.
The lanterns were delightfully festive, but the performance has definitely drawn to a close.
Mehh.
The midnight parade packed its paper lanterns and set off down the mountain path, humming softly.

clear:golems.title: Golem Forge: Cooling
clear:golems.blurb: The Forge Titan halts with a heavy groan, resembling a kettle cooling on the range.

lines.text: The Forge Titan seized up with a grinding screech, then came to a gentle halt like an iron stove.
FORGE... COOLING. PLEASE DO NOT TOUCH. STILL HOT.
He is quite serious, you know. You will blister your leather gauntlets.
We shall allow the ironwork to reach a sensible room temperature, then.
Watch the molten cinder on the grass. And mind your boot soles, everyone.
Mehh.
The stone sentinels stood frozen. It was unclear whether this was grief or the fire going out.

awaken:knight.title: Knight: Awakening
awaken:knight.blurb: A hero awakens: radiant light, a heightened presence and a dry observation.

lines.text: Sir Aldric held the outer gate for forty winters without questioning the king.
I feel three inches taller, and my pauldron seems to have doubled in acreage.
{hero} has awakened. The heightened splendour is quite blinding.
Mehh.

awaken:samurai.title: Samurai: Awakening
awaken:samurai.blurb: A hero awakens: radiant light, a heightened presence and a dry observation.

lines.text: He crossed the eastern strait bearing a single cold katana and a sacred vow.
The blade hums with cold fire. I shall attempt not to smile; it ruins my mystique.
{hero} has awakened. The heightened splendour is quite blinding.
Mehh.

awaken:kunoichi.title: Kunoichi: Awakening
awaken:kunoichi.blurb: A hero awakens: radiant light, a heightened presence and a dry observation.

lines.text: Moonlit slates and a whisper of wind are all she requires to work.
Now with forty percent more theatrical smoke and thirty percent less visibility.
{hero} has awakened. The heightened splendour is quite blinding.
Mehh.

earned:werewolf.title: Werewolf Enlists
earned:werewolf.blurb: A formidable beast earned through conquest rather than recruitment.

lines.text: The Beast Packs dispersed into the hills. One lingered behind to inspect who had achieved it.
Not half bad, for a couple of hairless bipeds in dented tin.
{hero} joins you.

earned:reaper.title: Reaper Enlists
earned:reaper.blurb: A collector of debts earned through persistence in the field.

lines.text: The Undead Legion marched for an age. Someone has to sign the receipts.
Your host was overdue. I have merely come to tally the remains.
{hero} joins you.

earned:demonSwordsman.title: Demon Swordsman Enlists
earned:demonSwordsman.blurb: A cursed blade changes masters after a dispute over wages.

lines.text: The Infernal Host boasted of its vanguard. It was one swordsman short.
I have left my old employers. The pension was atrocious.
{hero} joins you.

earned:samuraiCommander.title: Samurai Commander Enlists
earned:samuraiCommander.blurb: A decorated tactician decides to align his banner with a superior formation.

lines.text: The Night Parade departed into the mist. Its commander stayed to propose an alliance.
A splendid drill. I claim the silk banner; you may keep the turf.
{hero} joins you.

earned:juggernaut.title: Juggernaut Enlists
earned:juggernaut.blurb: A walking fortress decides to lend its bulk to the keep's defence.

lines.text: The Golem Forge went stone cold. One living rampart remained warm, largely out of stubborn habit.
Forge quiet now. Stone marches. I carry the luggage.
{hero} joins you.

earned:dreadPirate.title: Dread Pirate Enlists
earned:dreadPirate.blurb: A ghost ship runs aground at the breach and its crew offer to hold the walls.

lines.text: Twenty waves held at the Last Stand. A corsair crew came ashore to see who was holding.
Do not ask how we sailed a brigantine through a hole in your wall.
{hero} joins you.

earned:tyrant.title: Tyrant Enlists
earned:tyrant.blurb: An imperial magistrate descends from his high dais to offer supervision.

lines.text: Forty waves round one throne. Then a second throne arrived, with a tyrant on it.
Forty waves round your throne. I respect the stamina. Now cease hovering and bow.
{hero} joins you.

earned:timeWitch.title: Time Witch Enlists
earned:timeWitch.blurb: A temporal sorceress arrives precisely when she intended, which is yesterday.

lines.text: The Calamity was subdued. Somebody noted the disturbance and arrived slightly ahead of time.
Fret not regarding the future. I have already read the final chapter.
{hero} joins you.

earned:dragoon.title: Queen Dragoon Enlists
earned:dragoon.blurb: An aerial monarch investigates a sudden plume of volcanic heat.

lines.text: The Calamity reached ascension three. Something with scales came to see.
Adequately toasty. Shall we find something larger to annoy?
{hero} joins you.

earned:sage.title: Great Sage Enlists
earned:sage.blurb: A senior scholar reviews the bestiary and points out several errors.

lines.text: Half the monsters of the known world catalogued. An academic read the notes.
Fascinating. You have three beasts in completely the wrong genus.
{hero} joins you.

waveStart: Hold the line, my brave subjects! My throne is remarkably draughty!
Another wave arrives! Do try not to let them touch the velvet drapery!
Stand firm! Remember, your king is watching with supportive concern!
Here they come again! Strike them firmly and maintain proper decorum!
Protect the centre! I have proclamations to draft!
Banish these ruffians! They have not even paid the bridge toll!
bossWave: Good heavens, that one is enormous! Drop everything and hit it!
A chieftain approaches! Show him why our taxes are so high!
Look at the size of that club! Mages, kindly apply heavy fire!
He looks dreadfully bad-tempered! Keep him from the royal person!
By the crown, that is a monstrous brute! Heroes, earn your pensions!
A warlord in the field! Someone fetch my heavy sceptre and a meteor!
hurt: Ow! That clipped my crown! Mind the royal jewels, you barbarian!
Insolence! You have struck an anointed sovereign!
Ouch! That will leave a most undignified bruise on my regal shins!
Guards! A villain has laid hands on the royal person!
I say! That was entirely uncalled for!
Confound it! My ermine trim has been singed!
lowHp: The crown is slipping! Protect your monarch, you scoundrels!
I am feeling distinctly light-headed! Fetch a cleric and a cordial!
If I perish, the tax records are hidden behind the pantry shelf!
My kingdom for a healing potion! Or a moderately large wooden shield!
Hold them off! The royal knees are beginning to buckle!
The dynasty is flashing before my eyes! Rally, heroes, rally!
waveCleared: Splendid work! Consider your weekly rations marginally increased!
A magnificent repulse! My heart has almost returned to normal rhythm!
Huzzah! The scoundrels have been scattered like autumn leaves!
Exemplary violence, heroes! The crown expresses its sincere gratitude!
The perimeter holds! Sweep the debris and prepare for the next lot!
Well struck! Now, where did I place my royal cup of chamomile?
fallen: The crown has fallen... Tell the historian I went down swinging...
Darkness descends... Who will feed Duchess her afternoon thistles...
Alas, the keep is breached... My reign was glorious, if noisy...
The throne topples... Remember me as a king who liked fireworks...
Defeated on the carpet... This was not in the coronation oath...
Everything goes black... Mind the step on your way to the dungeon...

waveStart: They put the king right in the middle! First one to nick the crown gets lunch!
Surround them from all sides! The contract said nothing about fair play!
Charge the centre! The little crowned fellow looks like he can't run!
Swarm the hill! There are more of us than they have arrows!
Cut through the bodyguards! The sovereign has the fancy purse!
Attack from north and south! Let's get this done before the rain starts!
All together now! Don't let the wizard start waving his stick!
Forward, you lot! Management is watching from behind the treeline!
bossWave: Make way for the boss! He hasn't had his porridge and he's furious!
The warlord has arrived! Clear a path or he'll step on your head!
Here comes the big lad! Flatten the king and tear down the tent!
The chieftain is in the field! Look busy and follow his swing!
Heavy support is here! Bash down the tin knights and seize the monarch!
The boss says double rations if we bring him the royal signet ring!
Tremble, keep-dwellers! The master of the warband comes for your sovereign!
Clear the flanks! When the boss charges, he doesn't know how to steer!
